Bava Batra 9a:6-9b:1: Amar rav huna: bodkin limzonot, veen bodkin lichsut – i baet ema kera, vei baet ema sevara;

I baet ema sevara – hay ka mibbazze, vehay la ka mibbazze. i baet ema kera – "halo faros laraev lachmecha"; beshin ketiv – perosh, vahadar hav leh. vehatam ketiv: "ki tire arom vechissito"; "ki tire" – lealtar.
Verav yehuda amar: bodkin lichsut, veen bodkin limzonot – i baet ema sevara, vei baet ema kera;

I baet ema sevara – hay kamtzaara leh, vehay la kamtzaara leh. i baet ema kera – hacha ketiv: "halo faros laraev lachmecha" – peros lealtar, uchedikrenan; vehatam ketiv: "ki tire arom vechissito" – kesheyyerae lecha. tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: amar "kassuni" – bodkin acharav. "parnesuni" – en bodkin.

Tenan hatam: en pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom, mikkikkar befunedyon – mearba sein besela. lan – notnin lo parnasat lina. may "parnasat lina"? amar rav pappa: pureya uve sadya. shavat – notnin lo mezon shalosh seudot. tana: im haya mechazzer al happetachim – en nizkakin lo.

Hahu anya dahava mechazzer al happetachim, daata lekammeh derav pappa – la mizdekik leh. amar leh rav samma bereh derav yeva lerav pappa: i mar la mizdekik leh, inash acharina la mizdekik leh! lemut leh?! veha tanya: im haya ani hamechazzer al happetachim – en nizkakin lo! amar leh: en nizkakin lo lemattana merubba, aval nizkakin lo lemattana muetet.

Amar rav assi: leolam al yimna adam atzmo [millatet] shelishit hashshekel beshana, shenneemar: "veheemadnu alenu mitzvot latet alenu shelishit hashshekel bashshana laavodat bet elohenu". veamar rav assi: shekula tzedaka keneged kol hammitzvot, shenneemar: "veheemadnu alenu mitzvot vegomer" – "mitzva" en ketiv kan, ella "mitzvot".

(Siman: gadol, mikdash, moshe) amar rabbi elazar: gadol hameasse yoter min haose – shenneemar: "vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom, vaavodat hatztzedaka hasheket vavetach ad olam"; zacha – "halo faros laraev lachmecha". lo zacha – "vaaniyyim merudim tavi vayit".

Amar lehu rava livne machoza: bematuta manayychu, usu bahade hadade, ki hechi delehve lechu shelama bemalchuta. veamar rabbi elazar: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, adam shokel shiklo – umitkapper lo; achshav sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym, im osin tzedaka – mutav, veim lav – bain ummot haolam venotlin bizroa. veaf al pi chen nechshav lahen litzdaka – shenneemar: "venogsayich tzedaka".
Amar rava: hay milleta ishtai li ulla

"Meshaggesh orchatay deimmeh", mishshemeh derabbi elazar – may dichtiv: "vayyilbash tzedaka kashshiryon"? lomar lach: ma shiryon ze – kol kelippa ukelippa mitztarefet leshiryon gadol, af tzedaka – kol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol. rabbi chanina amar mehacha: "ucheveged iddim kol tzidkotenu"; ma beged ze – kol nima venima mitztarefet leveged gadol, af tzedaka – kol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol.
Berakhot 20a:4-9: Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: may shena rishonim deitrechish lehu nissa, umay shena anan dela mitrechish lan nissa? i mishshum tannoye, bishne derav yehuda kulle tannoye binzikin hava, vaanan ka matninan shitta sidre. vechi hava mate rav yehuda beuketzin, haishsha shekkoveshet yarak bakkedera, veamri la zetim shekkevashan betarfehen tehorim, amar: havayot derav ushemuel ka chazena hacha. vaanan ka matninan beuketzin telesar metivata, veillu rav yehuda ki hava shalef chad mesaneh, ate mitra, vaanan ka metzaarinan nafshin umitzvach ka tzavchinan, velet demashgach ban.

Amar leh: kammae havo ka masri nafshayyhu akkedushshat hashshem, anan la masrinan nafshin akkedushshat hashshem. ki ha derav adda bar ahava chazyay lehahi kutit dahavat levisha karbalta beshuka. sevar devat yisrael hi, kam kareh minna. iggallay milleta dechutit hi. shayyeymuha bearba mea zuze. amar la: ma shemich? amara leh: matun. amar la, matun — matun arba mea zuze shavya.

Rav giddel hava regil dahava ka azel veyatev ashshaare ditvila. amar lehu: hachi tevilu vehachi tevilu. amri leh rabbanan la ka mistefe mar miyyetzer hara? amar lehu: damyayn beappay ki kake chivvare.

Rabbi yochanan hava regil dahava ka azel veyatev ashshaare ditvila. amar: ki salkan benot yisrael veatyayn mittevila, mistakkelan bi, veneheve lehu zara deshappire kevoti. amri leh rabbanan: la ka mistefe mar meena bisha? amar lehu: ana mizzara deyosef ka atena, dela shalta beh ena bisha, dichtiv "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin", veamar rabbi avahu: al tikre "ale ayin", ella "ole ayin".
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz", ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassin alehem veen ayin hara sholetet bahem, af zaro shel yosef en ayin hara sholetet bahem.
Vei baet ema: ayin shello ratzta lizzon mimma sheeno shello — en ayin hara sholetet bo.

En baaron rak shene luchot haavanim asher hinniach sham moshe bechorev asher karat Adonai im-bene yisrael betzetam meeretz mitzrayim
Ketubot 72a:15-72b:2: Venoderet veenah mekayyemet. deamar mar: baavon nedarim banim metim, shenneemar: "al titten et picha lachati et besarecha vegomer". veezo hen maase yadav shel adam — heve omer banav uvenotav. rav nachman amar mehacha: "lashshav hikketi et benechem", "lashshav" — al iske shav.

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: kol hayyodea beishto shennoderet veenah mekayyemet — yachzor veyaddirenna. yaddirenna?! bemay metakken la? ella: yachzor veyaknitenna, kede shettiddor befanav veyafer lah. amru lo: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa.
Tanya, haya rabbi yehuda omer: kol hayyodea beishto sheenah kotze lo challa — yachzor veyafrish achareha. amru lo: en adam dar im nachash bichfifa.
Man dematne la aha, kol shekken ahach. aval man dematne ahach, aval ha — zimnin demikkere veachel.
Veezohi dat yehudit? yotza veroshah parua. roshah parua deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "ufara et rosh haishsha", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: azhara livnot yisrael shello yetzu bifrua rosh! deorayyta —
Kaltah shappir dame, dat yehudit — afillu kaltah name asur.

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kaltah, en bah mishshum perua rosh. have ba rabbi zera: hecha? illema beshuk — dat yehudit hi! veella bechatzer — im ken lo hinnachta bat leavraham avinu sheyyoshevet tachat balah! amar abbaye veittema rav kahana: mechatzer lechatzer vederech mavoy.
Menachot 44a:3-11: Tanya, amar rabbi natan: en lach kol mitzva kalla shekketuva betora, sheen mattan secharah beolam hazze, velaolam habba eni yodea kamma. tze ulemad mimmitzvat tzitzit.

Maase beadam echad shehaya zahir bemitzvat tzitzit, shama sheyyesh zona bichrakke hayyam shennotelet arba meot zehuvim bischarah, shigger lah arba meot zehuvim vekava lah zeman, keshehiggia zemanno, ba veyashav al happetach.

Nichnesa shifchatah veamra lah: oto adam sheshshigger lich arba meot zehuvim ba veyashav al happetach. amra hi: yikkanes. nichnas, hitztzia lo sheva mittot, shesh shel kesef veachat shel zahav, uven kol achat veachat sullam shel kesef, veelyona shel zahav.

Alta veyashva al gabbe elyona keshehi arumma, veaf hu ala leshev arom kenegdah, bau arba tzitziyyotav vetafchu lo al panav, nishmat veyashav lo al gabbe karka, veaf hi nishmeta veyashva al gabbe karka. amra lo: gappah shel romi, sheeni mannichatcha ad shettomar li ma mum raita bi.

Amar lah: haavoda, shello raiti ishsha yafe kemotech, ella mitzva achat tzivvanu Adonai elohenu vetzitzit shemah, uchetiv bah: "ani Adonai elohechem" shete feamim – ani hu sheatid lippara, vaani hu sheatid leshallem sachar. achshav nidmu alay kearbaa edim.
Amra lo: eni (mannichacha) [mannichatcha] ad shettomar li ma shimcha, uma shem ircha, uma shem rabbecha, uma shem midrashcha sheatta lamed bo tora. katav venatan beyadah.
Amda vechillekah kol nechaseha, shelish lammalchut, ushelish laaniyyim, ushelish natla beyadah, chutz meotan matztzaot.

Uvat levet midrasho shel rabbi chiyyay. amra lo: rabbi, tzavve alay veyaasuni giyyoret. amar lah: bitti, shemma enayich natat beechad min hattalmidim. hotziah ketav miyyadah venatna lo. amar lah: lechi zechi bemikkachich.
Otan matztzaot shehitztzia lo beissur, hitztzia lo behetter. ze mattan secharo baolam hazze, velaolam habba eni yodea kamma.
Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:1-5:
Haggozel umaachil et banav, vehinniach lifnehem, peturin milleshallem. veim haya davar sheyyesh bo acharayut, chayyavin leshallem. en portin lo mittevat hammochsin, velo mikkis shel gabbain, veen notlin mehem tzedaka. aval notel hu mittoch beto o min hashshuk: 
Natlu mochsin et chamoro venatnu lo chamor acher, gazlu listim et kesuto venatnu lo chesut acheret, hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen. hammatztzil min hannahar o min haggayis o min hallistim, im nityaashu habbealim, hare ellu shello. vechen nachil shel devorim, im nityaashu habbealim, hare ellu shello. amar rabbi yochanan ben beroka, neemenet ishsha o katan lomar, mikkan yatza nachil ze. umehallech betoch sede chavero lehatztzil et nechilo. veim hizzik, meshallem ma shehizzik. aval lo yakotz et socho al menat litten et haddamim. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, af kotzetz venoten et haddamim: 
Hammakkir kelav usefarav beyad acher, veyatza lo shem geneva bair, yishshava lo lokeach kamma natan, veyittol. veim lav, lo kol hemennu, sheani omer mecharan leacher ulekachan ze hemennu: 
Ze ba vechavito shel yayin veze ba vechaddo shel devash. nisdeka chavit shel devash, veshafach ze et yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letocho, en lo ella secharo. veim amar, atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li deme shelli, chayyav litten lo. shataf nahar chamoro vachamor chavero, shello yafe mane veshel chavero matayim, hinniach ze et shello vehitztzil et shel chavero, en lo ella secharo. veim amar lo, ani atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li et shelli, chayyav litten lo: 
Haggozel sade mechavero unetaluhu mesikin, im makkat medina hi, omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha, veim mechamat haggazlan, chayyav lehaamid lo sade acheret. shetafah nahar, omer lo, hare shellecha lefanecha:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:6-9:
Haggozel et chavero, o shellava hemennu, o shehifkid lo. bayyishshuv, lo yachazir lo vammidbar. al menat latzet bammidbar, yachazir lo vammidbar: 
Haomer lachavero, gezalticha, hilvitani, hifkadta etzli, veeni yodea im hechezarti lecha im lo hechezarti lecha, chayyav leshallem. aval im amar lo, eni yodea im gezalticha, im hilvitani, im hifkadta etzli, patur milleshallem: 
Haggonev tale min haeder vehecheziro, umet o nignav, chayyav beacharayuto. lo yadu vealim lo vignevato velo vachazirato, umanu et hatztzon ushelema hi, patur: 
En lokchim min haroim tzemer vechalav ugedayim, velo mishshomre ferot etzim uferot. aval lokchin min hannashim kele tzemer bihuda, uchele fishtan baggalil, vaagalim bashsharon. vechullan sheamru lehatemin, asur. velokchin betzim vetarnegolim mikkol makom:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:3-6:
Hammakke et aviv veet immo velo asa vahem chabbura, vechovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim, chayyav bechullan. hachovel beeved ivri, chayyav bechullan chutz min hashshevet, bizman shehu shello. hachovel beeved kenaani shel acherim, chayyav bechullan. rabbi yehuda omer, en laavadim boshet: 
Cheresh, shote vekatan, pegiatan raa. hachovel bahen chayyav, vehem shechavlu baacherim peturin. haeved vehaishsha, pegiatan raa. hachovel bahen chayyav, vehem shechavlu baacherim, peturin, aval meshallemin leachar zeman. nitgarsha haishsha, nishtachrer haeved, chayyavin leshallem: 
Hammakke aviv veimmo veasa vahen chabbura, vehachovel bachavero beshabbat, patur mikkullan, mippene shehu niddon benafsho. vehachovel beeved kenaani shello, patur mikkullan: 
Hattokea lachavero, noten lo sela. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili, mane. setaro, noten lo matayim zuz. leachar yado, noten lo arba meot zuz. tzaram beazno, talash bisaro, rakak vehiggia bo rukko, heevir tallito mimmennu, para rosh haishsha bashshuk, noten arba meot zuz. ze hakkelal hakkol lefi chevodo. amar rabbi akiva, afilu aniyyim shebbeyisrael, roin otam keillu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem, shehem bene avraham, yitzchak veyaakov. umaase beechad sheppara rosh haishsha bashshuk, bat lifne rabbi akiva, vechiyyevo litten lah arba meot zuz. amar lo rabbi, ten li zeman. venatan lo zeman. shemarah omedet al petach chatzerah veshavar et hakkad befaneha, uvo keissar shemen. gilleta et roshah, vehayta metappachat umannachat yadah al roshah. heemid aleha edim, uva lifne rabbi akiva. amar lo, rabbi, lazo ani noten arba meot zuz. amar lo, lo amarta kelum. hachovel beatzmo, af al pi sheeno rashshay, patur. acherim shechavlu bo, chayyavin. vehakkotzetz netiotav, af al pi sheeno rashshay, patur. acherim shekkatztzu et netiotav, chayyavim:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:7-9:4:
Af al pi shehu noten lo, en nimchal lo ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu, shenneemar (Bereshit 20) veatta hashev eshet vegomer. uminnayin shello yehe hammochel achzari, shenneemar (sham) vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim vayyirpa elohim et avimelech vegomer. haomer samme et eni, keta et yadi, shevor et ragli, chayyav. al menat liftor, chayyav. kera et kesuti, shevor et kaddi, chayyav. al menat liftor, patur. ase chen leish peloni, al menat liftor, chayyav, ben begufo ben bemamono: 
Haggozel etzim, vaasaan kelim, tzemer, vaasaan begadim, meshallem kishat haggezela. gazal para meubberet, veyalda, rachel teuna, ugezazah, meshallem deme fara haomedet leled, deme rachel haomedet liggazez. gazal para, venitabbera etzlo veyalda, rachel, venitana etzlo ugezazah, meshallem kishat haggezela. ze hakkelal, kol haggazlanim meshallemin kishat haggezela: 
Gazal behema vehizkina, avadim vehizkinu, meshallem kishat haggezela. rabbi meir omer, baavadim omer lo, hare shellecha lefanecha. gazal matbea venisdak, perot vehirkivu, yayin vehechmitz, meshallem kishat haggezela. matbea venifsal, teruma venitmet, chametz veavar alav happesach, behema veneevda vah avera, o shennifsela meal gabbe hammizbeach, o shehayta yotzet lissakel, omer lo, hare shellecha lefanecha: 
Natan leummanin letakken, vekilkelu, chayyavin leshallem. natan lecharash shidda, teva umigdal letakken, vekilkel, chayyav leshallem. vehabbannay shekkibbel alav listor et hakkotel, veshibber et haavanim o shehizzik, chayyav leshallem. haya soter mitztzad ze venafal mitztzad acher, patur. veim mechamat hammakka, chayyav: 
Hannoten tzemer letzabba, vehikdichato yora, noten lo deme tzamro. tzevao chaur, im hashshevach yoter al hayetzia, noten lo et hayetzia, veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach, noten lo et hashshevach. litzboa lo adom, utzevao shachor, shachor, utzevao adom, rabbi meir omer, noten lo deme tzamro. rabbi yehuda omer, im hashshevach yater al hayetzia, noten lo et hayetzia, veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach, noten lo et hashshevach:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:5-8:
Haggozel et chavero shave feruta, venishba lo, yolichennu acharav afillu lemaday. lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho, aval noten lishliach bet din. veim met, yachazir leyorshav: 
Natan lo et hakkeren velo natan lo et hachomesh, machal lo al hakkeren velo machal lo al hachomesh, machal lo al ze veal ze chutz mippachot mishshave feruta vakkeren, eno tzarich lelech acharav. natan lo et hachomesh velo natan lo et hakkeren, machal lo al hachomesh velo machal lo al hakkeren, machal lo al ze veal ze chutz mishshave feruta vakkeren, tzarich lelech acharav: 
Natan lo et hakkeren venishba lo al hachomesh, hare ze meshallem chomesh al chomesh, ad sheyyitmaet hakkeren pachot mishshave feruta. vechen befikkadon, shenneemar (Vayikra 5) befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et amito o matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al shaker, hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh veasham. hechan pikdoni, amar lo avad, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo, meshallem keren. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vachomesh veasham: 
Hechan pikdoni, amar lo nignav, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidin oto sheggenavo, meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vachomesh veasham:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:9-12:
Haggozel et aviv, venishba lo, umet, hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh levanav o leechav. veim eno rotze, o sheen lo, love uvaale chov baim venifraim: 
Haomer livno, konam i atta nehene mishshelli, im met, yirashennu. bechayyav uvemoto, im met, lo yirashennu, veyachazir levanav o leechav. veim en lo, love, uvaale chov baim venifraim: 
Haggozel et hagger venishba lo, umet, hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh lakkohanim veasham lammizbeach, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) veim en laish goel lehashiv haasham elav, haasham hammushav laAdonai lakkohen, millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav. haya maale et hakkesef veet haasham, umet, hakkesef yinnaten levanav, vehaasham yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava: 
Natan hakkesef leanshe mishmar, umet, en hayyorshim yecholin lehotzi miyyadam, shenneemar (sham) ish asher yitten lakkohen lo yihye. natan hakkesef lihoyariv veasham lidaya, yatza. asham lihoyariv vechesef lidaya, im kayyam haasham, yakrivuhu vene yedaya, veim lo, yachazir veyavi asham acher, shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi ashamo, yatza. hevi ashamo ad shello hevi gezelo, lo yatza. natan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh, en hachomesh meakkev:
Mishnah Challah 3:10-4:3: Hannotel seor meissat chittim venoten letoch issat orez, im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bachalla. veim lav, petura. im ken, lamma amru hattevel oser kol shehu, min bemino. veshello vemino, benoten taam:
Shete nashim sheasu shene kabbin, venagu ze vaze, afillu hem mimmin echad, peturim. uvizman shehem shel ishsha achat, min bemino, chayyav. veshello vemino, patur:
Eze hu min bemino, hachittim enan mitztarfot im hakkol, ella im hakkussemin. hasseorim mitztarfot im hakkol, chutz min hachittim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shear hamminim mitztarfin ze im ze:
Shene kabbim, vekav orez o kav teruma baemtza, enan mitztarfin. davar shennittela challato baemtza, mitztarfin, shekkevar nitchayyev bachalla:
Mishnah Challah 4:4-7: Kav chadash vekav yashan shennashchu ze vaze, rabbi yishmael omer, yittol min haemtza, vachachamim osrim. hannotel challa min hakkav, rabbi akiva omer, challa. vachachamim omrim, enah challa:
Shene kabbin shennittela challato shel ze bifne atzmo veshel ze bifne atzmo, chazar vaasao issa achat, rabbi akiva foter, vachachamim mechayyevin. nimtza chumro kullo:

Notel adam kede challa meissa shello hurema challatah, laasota betohora, lihyot mafrish aleha veholech challat demay ad shettissareach. shechallat demay nittelet min hattahor al hattame, veshello min hammukkaf:

Yisrael shehayu arisin lenachrim besureya, rabbi eliezer mechayyev perotehem bammaasrot uvashsheviit, verabban gamliel poter. rabban gamliel omer, shete challot besureya. verabbi eliezer omer, challa echat. achazu kullo shel rabban gamliel vekullo shel rabbi eliezer. chazru linhog kedivre rabban gamliel bishte derachim:
Mishnah Challah 4:8-11: Rabban gamliel omer, shalosh aratzot lachalla. meeretz yisrael vead keziv, challa echat. mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amana, shete challot, achat laur veachat lakkohen. shel ur yesh lah shiur, veshel kohen en lah shiur. min hannahar vead amana velifnim, shete challot, achat laur veachat lakkohen. shel ur en lah shiur, veshel kohen yesh lah shiur. utevul yom ochlah. rabbi yose omer, eno tzarich tevila. vaasura lazzavim velazzavot lannidda velayyoldot, veneechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan, venittenet lechol kohen:

Veellu nittanin lechol kohen, hacharamim, vehabbechorot, ufidyon habben, ufidyon peter chamor, vehazzeroa, vehallechayayim, vehakkeva, vereshit haggez, veshemen serefa, vekadshe hammikdash, vehabbikkurim. rabbi yehuda oser babbikkurim. karshine teruma, rabbi akiva mattir vachachamim osrim:

Nittay ish tekoa hevi challot mibbetar, velo kibbelu mimmennu. anshe alekkesanderiyya heviu challotehen mealekkesanderiyya, velo kibbelu mehem. anshe har tzevoim heviu vikkurehem kodem atzeret, velo kibbelu mehem, mippene hakkatuv shebbattora (Shemot 23), vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade:

Ben antinos heela vechorot mibbavel, velo kibbelu mimmennu. yosef hakkohen hevi vikkure yayin veshemen, velo kibbelu mimmennu. af hu heela et banav uvene veto laasot pesach katan birushalayim, vehecheziruhu, shello yikkava haddavar chova. ariston hevi vikkurav meappamya, vekibbelu mimmennu, mippene sheamru, hakkone vesureya, kekone befarvar shebbirushalayim:
Mishnah Kelim 22:10-23:3: Haasla, temea midras uteme met. persha, haor tame midras, vehabbarzel tame teme met. hatteraskal shechippuyo shel or, tame midras uteme met. persha, haor tame midras, vehatteraskal tahor mikkelum. safsalin shebbammerchatz ushete raglav shel etz, tame. achat shel etz veachat shel even, tahor. hannesarin shebbammerchatz sheshshiggeman, rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin, sheenam asuyin ella sheyyihyu hammayim mehallechin tachtehen. kankelin sheyyesh bah bet kabbalat kesut, temea. vehaasuya kechavveret, tehora:
Hakkaddur vehaimmum vehakkamea vehattefillin shennikreu, hannogea bahen, tame. uvema shebbetochan, tahor. haukkaf shennikra, hannogea bema shebbetocho, tame, mippene shehattefer mechabbero:

Ellu temein mishshum merkav, zarez haashkeloni, umedocha hammadit, veavit shel gamal, vetappetan shel sus. rabbi yose omer, af tappetan shel sus tame mishshum moshav, mippene sheomdin alav bakkumpon. aval ukkaf shel naka, tame:
Ma ben merkav lemoshav. merkav chalak maggao mimmassao, umoshav lo chalak maggao mimmassao. tafit shel chamor shehu yoshev aleha, tahor. shinna vah et hannekavin, o sheppertzan ze letoch ze, temea:
Mishnah Kelim 22:5-9:
Kisse shello hayu chippuyav yotzin, venittelu, tame, shekken darko lihyot mattehu al tziddo veyoshev alav: 
Kisse shennittal chippuyo haemtzai vehachitzonim kayyamim, tame. nittelu hachitzonim vehaemtzai kayyam, tame. rabbi shimon omer, im haya rachav tafach: 
Kisse shennittelu shenayim mechippuyav ze vetzad ze, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi yehuda, af kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav venishtayyer bo vet kabbala, tahor, mippene shebbatal haikkar uvatla hattefela: 
Shidda shennittal haelyon, temea mippene hattachton. nittal hattachton, temea mippene haelyon. nittal haelyon vehattachton, rabbi yehuda metamme mippene haddappin, vachachamim metaharin. yeshivat hassattat, tame midras: 
Kofet shesserko, vechirkemo, vaasao fanim, rabbi akiva metamme. vachachamim metaharin, ad sheyyachok bo. hassal vehakkalkala shemmilan teven o mochin, hitkinan lishiva, tehorin. sergan begemi o vimshicha, temein:
Mishnah Kelim 23:4-24:2: Hammitta vehakkar vehakkeset shel met, hare ellu temein midras. kisse shel kalla, umashber shel chayya, vechisse shel koves shehu chorem alav et hakkelim, amar rabbi yose, en bahem mishshum moshav:
Hacherem, tame mippene hazzuto. harshatot, vehammichmarot, vehammaddaf, vehappelatzur, umetzuddot hassecharin, temein. vehaakon, vehartov, vehakkeluv, tehorin:
Shelosha terisin hem. teris hakkafuf, tame midras. veshemmesachakin bo bakkunpon, tame teme met. veditzat haarviyyin, tehora mikkelum:
Shalosh agalot hen. haasuya chekattedra, temea midras. kemitta, temea teme met. veshel avanim, tehora mikkelum:
Mishnah Kelim 24:12-15: Shelosha orot hen. heasuy leshatiach, tame midras. letachrich hakkelim, tame teme met. veshel retzuot veshel sandalim, tehora mikkelum:
Shelosha sedinin hen. heasuy lishchiva, tame midras. levilon, tame teme met. veshel tzurot, tahor mikkelum:
Shalosh mitpachot hen. shel yadayim, tame midras. shel sefarin, temea teme met, veshel tachrich veshel nivle vene levi, tehora mikkelum:
Shelosha ferakilinin hen. shel tzade chayya vaof, tame midras. shel chagavin, tame teme met. veshel kayyatzin, tahor mikkelum:
Mishnah Kelim 24:3-7: Shalosh arevot hen. areva mishshene log vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka, temea midras. shelema, temea teme met. vehabbaa vammidda, tehora mikkelum:
Shalosh tevot hen. teva sheppitchah mitztziddah, temea midras. milmalan, temea teme met. vehabbaa vammidda, tehora mikkelum:
Shelosha tarbusin hen. shel sapparin, tame midras. sheochlin alav, tame teme met. veshel zetim, tahor mikkelum:
Shalosh besasiyyot hen. shellifne hammitta veshellifne sofrim, temea midras. veshel delufki, temea teme met. veshel migdal, tehora mikkelum:
Shalosh pinkasiyyot hen. haefiforin, temea midras. vesheyyesh bah bet kibbul shaava, temea teme met. vachalaka, tehora mikkelum:
Mishnah Kelim 24:8-11: Shalosh mittot hen. haasuya lishchiva, temea midras. shel zaggagin, temea teme met. veshel saragin, tehora mikkelum:
Shalosh mashpelot hen. shel zevel, temea midras. shel teven, temea teme met. vehappuchlatz shel gemallim, tahor mikkelum:
Shelosha mappatzim hen. haasuya lishiva, temea midras. shel tzabbain, tame teme met. veshel gittot, tahor mikkelum:
Shalosh chamatot veshalosh turemlin hen. hamekabbelim kashshiur, temein midras. vesheenan mekabbelin kashshiur, temeim teme met. veshel or haddag, tahor mikkelum:
Mishnah Orlah 1:1: Hannotea lisyag ulekorot, patur min haarla. rabbi yose omer, afillu amar happenimi lemaachol vehachitzon lisyag, happenimi chayyav, vehachitzon patur:
Mishnah Orlah 1:2-5:
Et shebbau avotenu laaretz, matzu natua, patur. natu, af al pi shello chibbeshu, chayyav. hannotea larabbim, chayyav. rabbi yehuda poter. hannotea birshut harabbim, vehannachri shennata, vehaggazlan shennata, vehannotea bisfina, vehaole meelav, chayyav baarla: 
Ilan shenneekar vehassela immo, shetafo nahar vehassela immo, im yachol lichyot, patur, veim lav, chayyav. neekar hassela mitztziddo, o shezzizeattu hammacharesha, o shezzizeo vaasao cheafar, im yachol lichyot, patur, veim lav, chayyav: 
Ilan shenneekar venishtayyer bo shoresh, patur. vechamma yehe hashshoresh, rabban gamliel omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota, kemachat shel mittun: 
Ilan shenneekar uvo verecha, vehu chayye mimmenna, chazra hazzekena lihyot kabberecha. hivrichah shana achar shana, venifseka, mone mishshaa shennifseka. sippuk haggefanim, vesippuk al gabbe sippuk, af al pi shehivrichan baaretz, muttar. rabbi meir omer, makom shekkochah yafe, muttar, vemakom shekkochah ra, asur. vechen berecha shennifseka vehi melea ferot, im hosif bematayim, asur:
Mishnah Orlah 1:6-9:
Netia shel arla veshel kile hakkerem shennitarvu vintiot, hare ze lo yilkot. veim lakat, yaale veechad umatayim, uvilvad shello yitkavven lilkot. rabbi yose omer, af yitkavven lilkot veyaale veechad umatayim: 
Healim, vehallulavim, ume gefanim, usemadar, muttarim baarla uvarvai uvannazir, vaasurim baashera. rabbi yose omer, hassemadar asur, mippene shehu peri. rabbi eliezer omer, hammaamid bisraf haarla, asur. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati beferush, shehammaamid bisraf healim uvisraf haikkarim, muttar, bisraf happaggim, asur, mippene shehem peri: 
Ankoklot, vehachartzannim, vehazzaggim, vehattemed shellahem, kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello, kelippe egozim, vehaggarinim, asurim baarla, uvaashera, uvannazir, umuttarin barvai. vehannovlot, kullan asurot: 
Rabbi yose omer, notin yichur shel arla, veen notin egoz shel arla, mippene shehu peri. veen markivin bechafniyyot shel arla:
Mishnah Orlah 2:1-5:
Hatteruma, uterumat maaser shel demay, hachalla vehabbikkurim, olim beechad umea, umitztarfin ze im ze, vetzarich leharim. haarla vechile hakkerem, olim beechad umatayim, umitztarfin ze im ze, veen tzarich leharim. rabbi shimon omer, enan mitztarfin. rabbi eliezer omer, mitztarfin benoten taam, aval lo leesor: 
Hatteruma maala et haarla, vehaarla et hatteruma. ketzad, sea teruma shennafla lemea, veachar kach naflu shelosha kabbin arla, o shelosha kabbin kile hakkerem, zo hi shehatteruma maala et haarla vehaarla et hatteruma: 
Haarla maala et hakkilayim, vehakkilayim et haarla, vehaarla et haarla. ketzad, sea arla shennafla lematayim, veachar kach nafla sea veod arla, o sea veod shel kile hakkerem, zo hi shehaarla maala et hakkilayim, vehakkilayim et haarla, vehaarla et haarla: 
Kol hamechammetz vehametabbel vehamedammea batteruma uvaarla uvechile hakkerem, asur. uvet shammay omrim, af metamme. uvet hillel omrim, leolam eno metamme ad sheyyehe bo kabbetza: 
Dostay ish kefar yitma, haya mittalmide vet shammay, veamar, shamati mishshammay hazzaken sheamar, leolam eno metamme ad sheyyehe bo kabbetza:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Shabbat shechala bechullo shel moed vechen rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat mitpallel arvit veshacharit umincha sheva berachot kishar hashshabbatot veomer yaale veyavo baavoda. bemusaf matchil bivracha emtzait beinyan shabbat umashlim beinyan shabbat veomer kedushshat hayyom beemtza beracha vechotem bah berashe chodashim mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael verashe chodashim. uvechullo shel moed chotem bah kemo shehu chotem beyom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat:

Veyom tov shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat mitpallel bivracha reviit ballayla vattodienu mishpete tzidkecha vattelammedenu laasot chukke retzonecha vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu kedushshat shabbat uchevod moed vachagigat haregel ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta veet yom hashshevii mishsheshet yeme hammaase hikdashta (vehivdalta vehikdashta et ammecha yisrael bikdushshatcha) vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesashon vechulei. uvemotzae shabbat uvemotzae yom tov shel kol hashshana mavdil beatta chonen af al pi shehu mavdil al hakkos:
Bachanukka uvefurim mosifin behodaa al hannissim. shabbat shechala lihyot bachanukka mazkir al hannissim bemusaf kemo shemmazkir bishar tefillot:

Bime hattaanit afillu yachid shehitanna mosif beshomea tefilla anenu vechulei. usheliach tzibbur omrah beracha bifne atzmah ben goel lerofe vechotem bah haone beet tzara (umoshia). venimtza mitpallel esrim berachot. betisha beav mosifin bevone yerushalayim rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal hair haavela kulei:

Kol yemot haggeshamim omer bivracha sheniyya morid haggeshem uvimot hachamma morid hattal. meematay omer morid haggeshem mittefillat hammusafin shel yom tov haacharon shel chag ad tefillat shacharit shel yom tov harishon shel pesach. umittefillat hammusafin shel yom tov harishon shel pesach omer morid hattal:

Mishshiva yamim bemarcheshvan shoalin et haggeshamim bevirkat shanim kol zeman shemmazkir haggeshem. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval beshinar uvesureya uvemitzrayim uvammekomot hassemuchot leellu vehaddomin lahen shoalin et haggeshamim beyom shishshim achar tekufat tishre:

Mekomot shehen tzerichin ligshamim bimot hachamma kegon iyye hayyam harchokim shoalin et haggeshamim beet shehen tzerichin lahen beshomea tefilla. umekomot shehen osin yom tov shene yamim omer morid haggeshem bitfillat musaf shel yom rishon shel shemini atzeret umitpallel veholech kol yemot haggeshamim:

Bamme devarim amurim bitfillat arvit veshacharit umincha. aval tefillat hammusafin shel rosh hashshana mitpallel tesha berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot shel kol yom veshalosh emtzaiyyot. rishona min haemtzaiyyot inyanah malchuyyot. sheniyya zichronot. shelishit shofarot. vechotem bechol achat mehen meinyanah:

Beyom hakkippurim mitpallel bechol tefilla mechamesh tefillot sheva berachot. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot veemtzaiyyot meen hayyom. vechotem bechol achat mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hakkippurim. veim chal lihyot beshabbat chotem bechol tefilla mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hakkippurim:

Beyom hakkippurim mitpallel bechol tefilla mechamesh tefillot sheva berachot. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot veemtzaiyyot meen hayyom. vechotem bechol achat mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hakkippurim. veim chal lihyot beshabbat chotem bechol tefilla mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hakkippurim:

Bamme devarim amurim beyom tzom shel kol shana veshana aval beyom tzom shel shenat hayyovel mitpallel tefillat hammusafim tesha berachot kemo shehitpallel bemusaf rosh hashshana vehem otan habberachot atzman lo pachot velo yoter veen mitpallelin otan ella bizman shehayyovel noheg:

Bechol tefilla mehattefillot poteach kodem livracha rishona <small>(Tehillim 51 17)</small> "Adonai sefatay tiftach ufi yaggid tehillatecha". ucheshehu chotem besof hattefilla omer <small>(Tehillim 19 15)</small> "yihyu leratzon imre fi" vegomer veachar kach tzoed laachorav:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:19-20: Lo yitten adam beerev shabbat kelim leumman nachri laasotan af al pi sheppasak immo. ella bichde sheyyetze bahen mibbeto kodem shechashecha. vechen lo yimkor adam chafatzav lenachri velo yashilennu velo yalvennu velo yemashkenennu velo yitten lo bemattana ella bichde sheyyetze beoto chefetz mippetach beto kodem hashshabbat. shekkol zeman shehu beveto en adam yodea ematay natan lo uchesheyyetze hannachri mibbeto beshabbat vechefetz yisrael beyado yerae kemi shehillevahu lannachri o mishkeno o pasak immo o machar lo beshabbat:

Hannoten iggeret lenachri leholichah leir acheret im katzatz immo sechar holacha muttar. vaafillu netanah lo erev shabbat im chashecha. vehu sheyyetze bah mippetach beto kodem hashshabbat. veim lo katzatz im yesh bammedina adam kavua shehu mekabbetz haiggerot vesholeach otam lechol medina umedina im sheluchav muttar litten lannachri haiggeret. vehu sheyyihye shehut bayyom kede sheyyaggia labbayit hassamuch lachoma kodem hashshabbat. shemma ze shemmekabbel haiggerot vesholchan beto samuch lachoma hu. veim en sham adam kavua lechach ella hannachri shennotnin lo haiggeret hu shemmolichah leir acheret asur lishloach beyad nachri haiggeret leolam ella im ken katzatz lo damim:
Niddah 19b:21-20a:3: Rav nachman amar: kedam hakkaza. metivi: maase vetala rabbi meir

Shabbat 153a:5-9: Tenan hatam, rabbi eliezer omer: shuv yom echad lifne mitatecha. shaalu talmidav et rabbi eliezer: vechi adam yodea ezehu yom yamut? amar lahen: vechol shekken, yashuv hayyom, shemma yamut lemachar, venimtza kol yamav bitshuva. veaf shelomo amar bechochmato: "bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim veshemen al roshcha al yechsar".

Amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: mashal lemelech shezzimmen et avadav lisuda, velo kava lahem zeman. pikchin shebbahen kishshetu et atzman veyashvu al petach bet hammelech, amru: kelum chaser levet hammelech? tippeshin shebbahen halchu limlachtan, amru: kelum yesh seuda belo torach?

Pitom bikkesh hammelech et avadav. pikchin shebbahen nichnesu lefanav keshehen mekushshatin, vehattippeshim nichnesu lefanav keshehen meluchelachin. samach hammelech likrat pikchim vechaas likrat tippeshim. amar: hallalu shekkishshetu et atzman lasseuda — yeshvu veyochlu veyishtu, hallalu shello kishshetu atzman lasseuda — yaamdu veyiru.

Chatano shel rabbi meir mishshum rabbi meir amar: af hen nirin kimshammeshin. ella ellu vaellu yoshvin: hallalu — ochlin, vehallalu — reevin. hallalu — shotin, vehallalu — tzemeim, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hinne avaday yochelu veattem tiravu hinne avaday yishtu veattem titzmau hinne avaday yaronnu mittuv lev veattem titzaku mikkeev lev".
Davar acher: "bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim" — ellu tzitzit, "veshemen al roshcha al yechsar" — ellu tefillin.
Zohar, Pekudei 48: Hechal noga ntztzch hechala telitaa. hechala da, hechala dekayyeyma binhiru illaa, yatir al kol illen kadmae. behechala da kayymin arba pitchin, chad listar darom, vechad listar mizrach, vechad listar tzafon, vechad listar maarav. bechol pitcha ufitcha it memana chada, dekayyeyma memana al kol pitcha ufitcha.

Pitcha kadmaa, da pitcha dekayyeyma beh chad memana, malkiel shemeh. veihu shallita al kol innun pitkin, denafke mibbe dina demalka, leitdena alma. (behahu pitka) begin dehay ihu memana leashgacha behu beinnun pitkin, uteren sofrin techot yedeh, chad mimina vechad missemala.

Lehay, ityeyhivu tikkune pitkin leatkena, ad la yifkun mehay tara levar, veyitmesaru bida dehahu memana, di behechala kadmaa. deha mizzimna deitmesaru bida dehahu memana divhechala kadmaa, ha nafke mitamman, velet reshu leatava lon.

Deha miyyad izdaman memana desitra achara mesaava, mareh dedina kashya takkifa, dela merachem, vesangadiel (sefer acher vasehadeyal) shemeh, veihu memana al tara dehechala kadmaa (sefer acher geris achara, velo geris kadmaa) di besitra achara, deihu gehinnam, vechamma innun gardini nimusin memanan leshatya bealma, uzeminin lemebad dina.

Uvegin kach, kayyeyma hahu memana leayyna befitkin, veinnun teren sofrin dekayyme techot memana da, shammashiel vekamuel, illen sofrin leatkena pitkin, vehahu memana alayyhu deihu malkiel. begin divinnun hechalin di bistar achara mesaava, itpekidu memanan yedian, behippucha meillen memanan di behechalin illen, vechol innun ruchin vechol innun memanan, detamman, kullehu leavasha.

Ta chaze, hay sangadiel (sefer acher sahedayal) kad natil pitka, missitra dehahu memana dekayyeyma lefitcha kadmaa, patach chad pitcha, lesitra dachashocha, deikre beer shachat, vetamman memanan elef verivvan zeminin lenatla innun pitkin, vehay memana alayyhu. ucheden charozin nafkin, vechamma gardine shatyayn bealma, vehahu dina ishtelim, veal da, memana da kayyeyma leayyna befitkin, uleatkena nimuse pitkin, ad la nafku mehay pitcha, vehay pitcha ihu pitcha dedarom.

Pitcha tinyayna, da pitcha dechayyin umotin talyayn beh, begin dehay pitcha, chatmin chatimin dechol pitkin, dechevan defitkin ittekanu kedka yeot, chad shamasha zammin, gazriel shemeh, venatil pitkin behay pitcha tinyayna, vetamman chatmin lehu.

Memana chada kayyeyma al hahu pitcha, veazriel shemeh, vechol pitcha ufitcha itkere al shema dehahu memana deitpakkeda aleh. hay memana techot shuletaneh, utechot yedeh, teren shammashin di shemahon (sefer acher 284) sanuriyya, adiel. chad mimina vechad missemala. hahu mimina, beh talyayn chayyin. vehahu dismala, beh talya mota. uteren chotamin bidayyhu, chotam chayyim vechotam mavet. da kaim lesitra da, veda kaim lesitra da.
Hay pitcha satim kol yome shatta, uveyoma deshavta, uveyome dechadsha itpetach, leachazaa chayyim behahu chotama, detalyayn beh chayyim, begin deshabbat vechodesh chotama dechayyim itkeyyaym behu.

Beyoma dechippure, deyisrael kullehu kayyme bitzlotin uvautin, umishtaddele befulechana demarehon, satim hahu pitcha, ad shaata ditzlota demincha. kevan deavar hay tzelota demincha, meatar be dina dehechala dizchuta, chad avira nafka, ufitcha da itpetach, vehay memana dehechala da kayyeyma, veinnun teren shammashin chad mimina vechad missemala, vechotame dechayyim umota bidayyhu, vechol pitkin dealma kammayyhu, ucheden achtimu hen lachayyim hen lamavet. veda hu pitcha demizrach.

Pitcha telitaa, da pitcha dekayyeyma bekiyyuma, leminda kol innun di dina yavar alayyhu, ben lemarin, ben lemachovin, ben lemiskenu. dina dela kayyeyma lemota. kad tara defitcha da sagir, keden dina itreshim al bar nash, dela tayyvin leh, bar bechela ditzlota takkifa, vetiuveta shelim. dichtiv (iyyov 12:14) yisgor al ish velo yippateach.

Chad memana kayyeyma al pitcha da, vekaftziel shemeh, vehay memana al pitcha da, begin lesagra hay pitcha, al hahu bar nash, deitchaze leitannesha, begin dela yitkabbal bitzlota, ad deyetuv lekame mareh.

Uvehahu zimna deitgezar dina bivnoy dela chavu, beinnun ravyayn zeirin, chad memana shamasha techot yedeh, iriel shemeh, venafak vechariz listar semala, ad deitar chad rucha, deihu rucha difgimu, (264 amud bet) itbere bifgimu desihara, veikre askara, vehay ihu rucha dekayyeyma al darga (sefer acher pitcha) reviaa, behechala telitaa, di bistar mesaava, veda kayyeyma al kittula dilhon, veyitchaze lon leravye, keitteta dirviat leravye, vaachidat lon, vekatlat lon.

Ucheden hahi nishmeta, salleka, veachid lah hay memana, vesalleka lah lammana dekayyeyma al hechala reviaa, vehahu memana megaddela lon, veishtasha behu, vesalik lon leitchazaa kamme malka kadisha, bechol shabbat veshabbat, uvechol resh yarcha veresh yarcha, veitchazun kameh, veitbarchun minneh. uveshaata derugeza shalta, istakkal behu kudesha berich hu, vechayyis al alma.

Vechol innun ravyayn, dela ashlimu shenin, ad telesar shenin veyoma chad, kullehu itmesaru bida dehay, (264 amud bet) mittelesar shenin ad esrin, kullehu itmesaru al yeda derucha achara, deikre agiryson, denafka mehay nachash (sefer acher akima) amika, degarim mota lechol alma, veihu yetzer hara. meesrin shenin uleella, itdan bar nash mibbe dina, atar deikre zechuta, ihu begarmeh ata, uvechovoy itdan, veitmesar bida dehay chivya deihu malach hammavet.

(Begin deha measserin shenin uletatta, ad telesar shenin), hay rucha dekayyeyma beh kenachash, azil avatreh, da agirison dekaamaran. begin dela itnetir kad hava ravya dakik kedka yeot. vechame beh siman deyitpegim levatar. vehay itnetil bela reshu, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat. veraza da ketiv (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod, vetanenan, vehinni tov meod, da malach hammavet, deakdim leh ad la yitpegim levatar. vehay memana dekaim al hay pitcha, ail nishmateh vesalleka lah leella.

Mittelesar shenin uletatta, itdan al chovoy deavoy, veitmesar bida dehay askara dekaamaran. vechol chad vechad, hechala da lokovel hechala da. da behippucha min da, kidkamran, vehay pitcha ihu listar tzafon.

Pitcha reviaa, pitcha da kayyeyma leasvavta, veikre pitcha deasvavta, behay pitcha kayyeyma chad memana, (252 amud alef) pedayel shemeh. vehay kayyeyma al kol innun asvavtin dealma, uleaala tzelotin dechol innun mare demachovin umarin vetzarin, vehay ihu salik bechol (nusach acher lechol) innun tzelotin, veail lon kame kudesha berich hu.

Vehay ihu (iyyov 33:23) malach melitz echad minni alef, begin deinnun elef kayymin behahu pitcha, vehay chad minnayyhu, uchetiv vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer. begin desalik behay (nusach acher lehay) tzelota, vekayyeyma melitz tov aleh devar nash, veadkar zechuteh deavad kame malka kadisha, begin dehay ihu dekayyeyma tadir letav, veal da, kol asvavta kayyeyma behay pitcha di pedayel memana beh. pitcha da ihu listar maarav. uvegin da, illen arba pitchin kayymin behechala da.

Behechala da kayyeyma rucha chada deikre noga, hay ihu rucha shallita behay hechala, kol ziva vechol tiuveta kayyeyman beh. hay rucha ihu kayyeyma lechol innun deit lon chulaka bealma deate, da attar leinnun nishmatin beziva diykara, begin leminda kol innun ruchin di behechalin acharanin, deda ihu bar alma deate, veyyavar bechullehu, velet man deyimche bideh.

Hay rucha, ihu rucha dachya, barir meillen tatain, zahariel shemeh, mehahu mishcha dirvut kudesha denagid mealma deate, nagid beh, umehahu mishcha itbare (nusach acher itrabbe) veatzmach. vehay ihu ner, kema deat amer (Tehillim 132:17) arachti nir limshichi. begin dehay ihu siddura leadleka butzinin mitatta leella, kad shara aleh nehiru denagid milleella, begin dehay itsadar, kad itkelilu beh kol innun tattain letatta.

Vechad itsadar hay rucha bechol innun tattain, venahir, keden afik minneh nehora chad, di shemeh akariel (sefer acher 51) vehay kalil berucha da, hay kayyeyma techot (sefer acher hay) rucha, leamshecha (sefer acher laamashechaa) lechol innun nishmatin desallekin, deit lon chulaka bealma deate, veitchazun lesalleka leella.

Begin dechad nishmeta salleka, vealat beinnun hechalin tattain, reshima ihi beesrin (210 amud alef) uteren atvavn deorayyta, dirshimin behay nishmeta. vechad nishmeta zachat vekamat kammeh dehahu rucha, da memana ahadiel mashach lon. vesalkin vealin behahu nehar dinur vesallekin veitkerivu lekarbana.

Hay nehora kalil bitlat nehorin, begin dehahu revut mishcha, itkelil bitlat gevavnin. vechad natzitz hay nehora, natzitz minneh esrin uterin (atvavn) nehorin, lokovel 22 atvavn deorayyta, dirshimin behay nishmeta. veillen esrin uteren nehorin, kullehu memanan shammashin dekayyme immeh, vechullehu itkerun al shema dehay nehora dealayyhu, vechullehu itkelilu beh. hay nehora bechol innun nehorin, itkelil behay rucha, vehay rucha kalil beh, veistache leityashsheva go hechala reviaa.

Rucha da, kad itkelil minnehora da, umichullehu nehorin, kad dachayyayn (nusach acher dachakin) leitnatztzetza nafka minnayyhu chad chevata kadisha, kelila bitre gevavne, arya venishra, veihi chad diyyukena, vehay ikre ahiel. (sefer acher 442)

Vehay chevata kadisha, nafke minnetzitzu dilah, kad mate nehiru dehay rucha illaa bah, arba ofannim, kelilan bechol gevavnin, veinnun haderiel, yehadriel, ahadoriya, (hakedama 14 amud bet) asimon (nusach acher 116). kol illen bitmanya gadpin, veillen innun memanan, al kol chele shemaya, maggiche kerava. begin dela ishtechach kerava bealma, o akiru demalchuta meatrayyhu, ad dechele shemaya, vechochavayya dishar rekiin, kullehu achziu keravin vesichsuchin illen beillen. veillen arba ofannim, kayyme alayyhu learba sitrin dealma.

Illen arba, kad natlin leaggacha keravin, meraza dehechala dilella natlin, deihu be dina, veikre zechuta. mizzia dilhon appiku kama chelin umashshiryayn delet lon chushebana. vechullehu kayyme techot illen ofannim.

Minnehon kayyme al shirata, uminnehon shelichan al alma. lokovel innun shelichan delistar mesaava, denafke miggo hahu hechala telitaa dilah, veinnun mekatrege alma leavasha. veillen ishtechachu lokovlayyhu, dela yishletun legabbe innun demishtaddele beorayyta, kema deat amer (Tehillim 91:12) ki malachav yetzavve lach vegomer. uchetiv al kappayim yissaunecha pen tigof baeven vegomer. da (Yeshayahu 8:14) even negef tzor michshol. hay ikre even negef tzor michshol. vehay ikre (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan pinnat yikrat, (Yeshayahu 28:16) tzor yisrael. vecholla kayyeyma da lokovel da.

Meraza dehechala telitaa di besitra achara, nafke teren ruchin, deikrun af vechema, umitteren illen, nafkin kol innun shelichan deazlin leastaa beni nasha mearcha dikshot, veillen innun dekayyeyman, veakdimu al bar nash, deka azil leorcha demitzva. veal da illen ofannim kayyman lokovlayyhu, begin leaggana aleh debar nash dela yitnazkun. meillen teren ruchin dachil moshe, kad hava nachit min tura, dichtiv, (Devarim 9:19) ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema.

Beemtzaita dehechala da, it atra achara, dekayyeyma leella leella, bearba pitchin, learba sitre alma, eser memanan lechol pitcha ufitcha, vechad memana alayyhu. vehay kalil binhora deikre ahadiel, vehay ihu ofan betoch haofan, meshullavan da beda.

Illen arbein, natle dina mibbe zechuta, lealkaa lehay nishmeta dechavat (sefer acher vabeaat) lealkaa. veillen kayyme beshalhove nura legabbe innun nishmatin, vetasin levar mehechala da, vealkan lenishmeta da, vekayyeyma nezifa levar, kol innun yomin deitgezarat alah, vela alat lefargoda.

Veillen arbaim, innun dekayymin vaanzifu umenaddin, lechol innun deappiku mippumayyhu milla dela itztericha, uvatar da appiku mippumayyhu milla kaddisha, milla deorayyta, umetanfe pumayyhu bah. veillen kayyme, umenaddin lon, vekayyme behay nidduyay arbein yomin, dela ishtema tzelothon.

Vechen lechol innun dechavu innun chovin, devayayn lenazfa, asara karozin nafke bechol yoma, umachreze bechol innun rekiin, uvechol innun chelin umashshiryayn, izdeharu biflanya deihu nezifa. nezifa ihu al chova peloni deavad, ad detav kamme marih, rachamana lishezvan.

Kad tav mehahu chova, mitkannefe illen arbein, vesharan leh. ucheden achrizu aleh, pelanya shara nezifa. mikkan ulehala tzelota alat. vead la tav, nazif ihu leella vetatta, unetiru demareh itade minneh. vaafillu belelya nishmateh nezifa, desatmin lah kol tare shemayya vela salleka, vedachyayn lah levar.

Hay ofan dekayyeyma al illen arbein, kad natil mata lehahu atar deikre (Melachim 1 14:28) ta haratzim. vechad al, alu immeh innun arbein, di memanan bearba pitchin, vesallekin kol innun meginnin di dahava. veillen innun malachin deikrun chashmalim. veinnun meginnin vesayyfin verumechin, derahate leaggana alayyhu deyisrael mishshear ammin, uleaggacha kerava behu, ulenakma lon kefum shaata, bela arichu.

Uvegin kach ikre ta haratzim, atar deinnun ratzim rahate, veochu leaggacha, ulenakma nukemin lokovel ratzim acharanin, derahate leavasha uleatrea mazzalin, leshalletaa alayyhu. veraza da, (Ester 3:15) haratzim yatzu dechufim. ratzim missitra da, veratzim missitra da, uveginehon, (Ester 8:15) vehair shushan tzahala vesamecha, o (Ester 3:15) navocha. i mekaddeme illen dehacha, hair shushan samecha. vei mekaddeme illen desitra achara, hair shushan navocha.

Veha okimna, divcholla kayymin illen lokovel illen, sitra da lokovel sitra da. uvegin kach, illen innun meginnin lecholla. kad sallekin illen beillen, nafak chad avera dilella, veitavidu kullehu magen chad. vesimanich, (bareasheytetav) anochi magen lach.

Teresar galgallin, innun desacharan go hechala da, veinnun ikrun serafim, ditren gavvnin, chivvavr vesumak, rachame vedina, illen innun kayyme leashgacha tadir, al kol innun mare detzaara, detzarin lon shear ammin, vedachakin lon, veikrun challonot. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:9) mashgiach min hachallonot.

Veillen kayyme leistakkela, kol innun dimtzallan tzelotayyhu, dimkaddeme leve kenishta, veitmenun meinnun asara kadmae. keden sallekin vechatvin lon leella, begin deillen ikrun chaverim legabbayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 8:13) chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deyade lesaddera tzelothon kedka yeot, begin dechad hay tzelota sharat leistalleka, illen sallekin behay tzelota, vealin bechol innun rekiin, uvechol innun hechalin, ad tara defitcha illaa, vealat hahi tzelota kame malka, leitattera. kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, kol innun dimtzallan tzelotin, umekaddeshe lemarehon biruta shelim, hay tzelota baya leappaka lah miggo machashava, uviruta demilula verucha, ucheden itkaddash shemeh dekudesha berich hu. vechad matat legabbe illen chaverim, kullehu natle lehahi tzelota, veazlan bahadah ad hechala reviaa, behahu pitcha. veillen meshabbechin behahu zimna dimtzallan tzelotin, umekaddeshe behahu zimna, illen innun di memanan bimama behu beyisrael, lemeheve immehon chaverim. (sefer acher velav belelya keinnun) uvelelya, beinnun acharanin, deamre shirata belelya.

Veta chaze ketiv, (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit. veha okmuha, begin demana birchan dekudesha berich hu, deihu aviv. kema dichtiv, (Devarim lak) sheal avicha veyaggedcha. uchetiv (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha. veukemuha.

Chaver hu leish mashchit, man ish mashchit. da ihu hahu ish, defagim lesihara. veikre (Mishlei 16:28) ish tahpuchot. (Tehillim 140:12) ish lashon. (Bereshit 25:27) ish yodea tzayid ish sade. vehay ihu ish mashchit, dehay ihu mana birchan mealma. uf hachi, man demana birchan mealma, chaver hu lehay ish mashchit kidkamran. veda hu raza, begin deitzterich leh lebar nash levarcha lekudesha berich hu, uletzallaa tzelota kadka yeot. begin deyitbarach shemeh kaddisha, veyitchabbar beillen chaverin kaddishin, vela yifgom tzeloteh. begin deyimna birchan mealma, veyitchabbar behahu chaver ish mashchit deihu mana birchan mealma, vegarim mota lechullehu.

Ketiv (Devarim 18:11) vechover chaver, may vechover chaver. hahu man deazil batar sitra achara, vecharash charshin, ihu mashich aleh rucha achara mesaava, veitchabbar behahu chavruta dehahu chaver ra, veshaari bechavruta bahadeh, hahu chaver ish mashchit. amay ikre chaver. begin divshaata deityeylid bar nash itchabbar immeh. vetadir kayyma bahadeh chaver. levatar, ithappach leh chaver, ish mashchit.

Vehachi it besitra dikdushsha, besitra dimina, chaver tov, deavid tivu immeh devar nash bealma den uvealma deate. veillen chaverim kayyme tadir aleh debar nash, bechavruta chada, leshezava leh, uleaggana aleh, ulemehve immeh chaverim, lekaddesha shema demarehon, ulezammera uleshabbecha kammeh. tadir.

Meillen nafke arba samchin acharanin, leinnun teresar dekaamaran, hane chaverim. veillen innun kayyme legabbe innun deyatin eta leavasha letzaddikayyay. af al gav dela avde, vesalke veode milla leella, uvatle lehahu eta, veillen ikrun erellim veaf al gav dechullehu itmenun leda, kol chad vechad itmana veitpekad al millin yedian. utechot illen let lon chushebana.

Illen arba, kayyme learba sitre alma, vechol chad kaim leashgacha alayyhu deyisrael. veillen ikrun charakkim, kema deat amer (Shir hashshirim 2:9) metzitz min hacharakkim. shema deillen arba deikrun charakkim, igael. iriya (nusach acher 292). ariel. yehirael. igael, ihu kaim listar mizrach, veda kayyeyma leashgacha al kol innun deavdin ovadin tavin, veal kol innun dimchashsheve machashava demitzva, af al gav dela yachle lemebad.

Iriya, kayyeyma listar darom. veda kayyeyma leashgacha, lechol innun dimnachame lemiskena, o detzaare libbayyhu aleh, af al gav dela yachle lemehav leh. uleinnun deazle leorcha demitzva. uleinun deavde chesed im metim. veihu kayyeyma kiuma deemet. vehay itmana leadkera leh leella, uleachaka diyyukeneh leella, leaala leh lealma deate.
Ariel, kayyeyma listar tzafon. veda kayyeyma leashgacha lechol innun dachashivu lemebad bishin, vela avde. o baan lemechote, veatu lemebad, veittakaf beyitzreh vela avid.

Yehirael, kayyeyma listar maarav. vehay kayyeyma leashgacha lechol innun delaan beorayyta. veayyle benayyhu lemile beorayyta leve rav. ulechol innun demistakkele al mera, kad ihu beve mareh. veashgachu aleh, veodiu leh deyistakkal bechovoy uveovadoy, veyetuv minnayyhu lemareh. begin dechol man deyishtaddal behahu mera, deyistakkal beovadoy, veyetuv betiyyuveta kame kudesha berich hu, ihu garim leh leishtezava, uleatava leh rucheh. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 41:2) ashri maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. may beyom raa, beyom ra mibbae leh. ella beyom raa, beyoma deshalta hahu raa lemesav nishmateh. ashre maskil el dal, da hu mera. kema deat amer, (Shmuel b 13:4) madua atta kacha dal ben hammelech. uvegin kach, beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai.

Veillen (sefer acher inun demistakkele) deinnun mistakkele behahu mera, leatava leh mechovoy gabbe kudesha berich hu, kema deokimna. behechala da kayyeyma aleh, leashgacha. uveyoma desharya dina al alma, yishteziv minneh, kema deat amer beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. yoma deittemsar dina lehahi raa leshalletaa beh (al alma) vechullehu illen kayyme leashgacha. veal da ikrun charakkim.

Beyoma derosh hashshana, kad kudesha berich hu kaim bedina al alma, vehahu sitra bisha ate leastaa, keden mitkannefe kol hane, vekayyman kame kudesha berich hu. ucheden mitatteran kullehu, vekayyman kame kudesha berich hu. behahu zimna ma ketiv, mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim. metzitz: keman deashgach meatar dakik, dechame vela chame kol ma deitzterich. ulevatar, mashgiach min hachallonot, atar ashgachuta yattir, defatach pitchin lerachama al kolla, vechad kudesha berich hu ashgach al alma, istakkal beillen challonot, uveillen charakkim, vechayis al kolla.

Ucheden kad yisrael takin behahu shofar veittear mittatta hahu kol denafik mishshofar, kalil meeshsha umaya verucha, veitavid mikkolla hahu kol, begin leitteara kol illaa, denafka miggo hahu shofar, deihu kegavvna da, kalil beeshsha uvemmaya verucha. keden karoza nafka, veachriz bechullehu rekiin, veamar kol dodi hinne ze ba vegomer, mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim.

Ucheden yade kullehu, deha kudesha berich hu chayis alayyhu deyisrael, veamre zakkain innun yisrael, deit lon eta beara, begin leitteara rachame milleella, keden ketiv (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua, yode terua vadday, yode terua: metabbere hay terua, deihu dina kashya, decholla itdanu be. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, begin deinnun yade archoy dekudesha berich hu, veyade lemehach bearchoy, uleyachada yichuda kedka yeot.

Illen challonot, veillen charakkim, kayyme kullehu leachada kol tzelotin, desallekin mittatta leella, uleashgacha behu, leaala lon kame kudesha berich hu. veal da kol bet hakkeneset delav beh challonot, lav atar letzallaa beh kedka yeot.

Deha bet hakkeneset letatta, lokovel bet hakkeniset dilella. bet hakkeneset dilella deit beh (59 amud bet) challonot kema deamaran, hachi name letatta. leella keneset haggedola, it beh teresar challonot illain, hachi name lehay bet hakkeneset tattaa. vecholla kayyeyman da lokovel da, begin dealmin kayymin illen begavvna deillen, vekudesha berich hu salik yekareh becholla. veal da beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai, kad shalta hahi sitra bisha, yemalletehu Adonai.

Kegavvna da, hay memana yehirael, kayyeyma al kol innun dechayyse al miskene, kema deat amer ashre maskil el dal. uvegin da kolla kayyeyma behechala da, vehechala da itkelil behechala achara reviaa, detamman hu gizrin vedinin lecholla. zakkaa chulakeh man deyada ginze demareh, leyachada leh, ulekaddesha shemeh demareh tedira, lemizke leh bealma den uvealma deate.
Zohar, Pekudei 52: Hechal kodesh hakkodashim dizer divria hechala sheviaa. hechala da, hechala penimaa mikkol hani hechalin. hay hechala ihu setimu, delav beh diyyukena mammash, velet gufa kelal. hacha setimu dego raza derazin, hay ihu raza, deihu atar, leaala tamman bego innun tzinnorin dilella. rucha dechol ruchin, raavavn dechol raavivyn, leitchabbera kolla kachada. rucha dechayye (deha) behay, lemehve kolla tikkuna chada.
Hechala da, ikre (255 amud bet) bet kodesh hakkadashim. atar lokovla hay (sefer acher nishmeta illaa) nishmatin illain, deikre hachi, leatara alma deate legabbeh.

Hay alma olam ikre. olam: selika, desalik alma tattaa legabbe alma illaa, veistattar begavev, veitalam beh, itgalyay bistira. olam: desalik ihu, bechol innun dekarvin beh, veistatteran go setiru illaa. olam illaa: salik veistattar biruta illaa, go temiru dechol temirin dela ityeyda kelal (kelal), vela itgele, velet man deyada leh.

Parochta defarsa perisa, chafyya go temiru satim. kapporta perisa go temirin illain, leastema setimin deha temirin usetimin. (nusach acher parochta perisa go tehirin illain distama setima dehay tamir vesatim) lego min kapporta, it atar satim vetamir veganiz, leachnasha leh begaveh. meshach revut illaa, rucha dechayye, al yeda dehahu nahar denagid venafik, vehahu nahar ikre mabbua devera, dela paskin memoy lealmin. vechad hay ayel venagid kol hahu revut kudesha milleella, meatar dekodesh hakkodashim. nehiru negidu nachit veate, go innun tzinnorin. hay itmalleyay mittamman, kenukeba demitabbera veitmalleya min dechura.

Uf hachi name hay hechala, mittakna tadir lekabbela, kenukeba dimkabbela min dechura. kabbilu dekabbilu, kol innun ruchin venishmatin kadishin denachtin lealma, veitabberu (sefer acher vaataakabev) tamman. kol hahu zimna deitzterich.

Yitakkevun ad deyete malka meshicha, veyistappekun kol innun nishmatin, veyetun veyachde alma kemillekaddemin. ucheden, yachde kudesha berich hu kemillekaddemin, kema deat amer (tehillim 104) yismach Adonai bemaasav.

Behay hechala, kayymin innugin vetafnukin deruche, veishtasheuta deishtaasha kudesha berich hu beginta deeden. hacha ihu tiuveta decholla, veinnuga decholla, leitchabbera kolla kachada, ulemeheve kolla chad, kishshura decholla beyichuda chada hacha kayyeyma.

Dechad shayyfe kullehu mitchabberan beshayyfin illain, kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh, let lon tiuveta, velet lon innuga, bar beyichuda dehay hechala, kolla hacha talya. kad itchabberuta dehacha ityaychad beyichuda chada, keden kol nehiru deshayyfin, vechol nehiru deanpin, vechol chedvavn, kullehu nehirin vechadan.

Zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lesaddera siddurin, uleatkena tikkuni ishtalmuta kedka yeot, rechimu dekudesha berich hu behay alma, uvealma deate. ucheden, kol dinin, vechol gizrin bishin, mitabberin umitvattelin mealma.

Hechala da, hechala detiuveta, hechala deinnuga, hechala leishtashea ella vetata kachada. umekabbela kolla nehiru devutzina illaa denahir lecholla, uleityaychada kolla kedka yeot. beyichuda shelim. veal da, hechala da kaim bitmiru decholla, ganiz mikkolla. af al gav dechullehu temirin. da tamir veganiz yatir. lemeheve berit kayyayma kolla kachada, dechar venukeba lemehevi shelim.

Hechol da ikre aron habberit, deihu adon kol haaretz. begin dehay ihu atar, denafku minneh kol nishmatin dealma, leyachada yichuda letatta, uleamshacha yichuda dekudesha berich hu meella letatta, leyahava latztzadik, begin denafku (vayyetze 155 amud bet) mitzaddik, veayyle betztzaddik. ulevatar nafke mitzadik, veayyle baatar denafke mitamman.

Hay aron habberit, nakit kolla mitztzaddik. ulevatar, nafke minneh, veayyle betztzaddik letatta. levatar nafke mitztzaddik diltatta, veayyle behay aron habberit. lemeheve kol nishmatin kelilan meella umitatta. lemeheve shelim mikkol sitrin. vehay aron habberit, nakit mitztzaddik innun nishmatin, mitteren sitrin.

Ta chaze, mabbua devera la mitparsha mibbera lealmin, veal da, hay atar, shichlula decholla, kiuma dechol gufa, lemeheve shelim becholla kedka yeot. hacha, hu yichuda vekishshura kachada, lemeheve ella vetatta chad, bekishshura chada, dela mitparshan kol shayyfin da min da, uleishtachcha kolla anpin beanpin.

Veal da tanenan, man deshamish arseh meachora, achchish tikkuna deistakkeluta anpin beanpin, leanhara kolla kachada, uleishtachcha kolla anpin beanpin, bidvekuta kadka yeot, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:24) vedavak beishto, beishto dayyka, vela achore ishto.

Teren innun, yaakov ihu leella, yosef letatta. teren tiuvetin innun. chad hechala shetitaa. vechad hay hechala sheviaa. tiuveta leella, beinnun neshikin denatil yaakov. tiuveta letatta, behay shimmusha denatil yosef. mitteren sitrin illen, natil (hay) aron habberit rucha dechayye. missitra deyaakov, natil rucha dechayye dilella, deitdavak beh beinnun neshikin, veail (beinnun neshikin) (nusach acher veayil) rucha dechayye dilella beh, leitzena minnih. missitra deyosef, deihu letatta, besiuma degufa, behay hechala. natil ruchin venishmatin learka letatta, lehay alma.

Illen teren sitrin, mitparshan litren sitrin. sitra deyaakov, itpashat veyahiv tukepa, lenava beinnun shadayim, deitmalleyayn mehahu rucha dechayye, veyanik behu leinnun malachin kadishin, deinnun chayyin vekayymin lealmin, vekayymin bekiyyuma beh, sitra deyosef, ayiyil betiuveta veyahav tukepa lego, veavid nishmatin veruchin, lenachta letatta, uleatzena behu bene alma.

Veal da, kayymin teren sitrin illen, da leella, veda letatta. da leatzena leella, veda lemezan letatta. kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh, (veal da) vecholla ihu chad, vechad raza ihu. veim kol da, yosef zan lechol gufa, veashke leh. demehay rucha dechayye deitdabbekuta deyaakov, nachit letatta, uveh itdavak hay aron habberit, biruta leella, venachit hahu rucha dechayye letatta, behahu itdabbekuta deyosef, vechad itchabbar kolla kachada, itmalleyayn innun shadayim leyanka lecholla, uvegin kach kolla ihi chad, zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lekashshera kishrin, uleyachada yichuda bitzlote biruta delibba kedka yeot, begin ledabbeka shayyfa beshayyfa, rucha berucha, kolla bichlala chada, lemeheve kolla chad kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, hay hechala, kad illen ruchin kadishin, vechol innun hechalin uretichin, kullehu mityaychade kachada, veishtechachu bekishshura chada, keden hay rucha illaa dechullehu, deihu nekuda chada, astim behu, vela itgalyay, veitavid rucha satim kegavvna illaa. vesimanich egoza, yichuda bekishshura decholla kidkamran, leitkashshera da beda, lemehve kolla shelim, bishlimu (dechar venukeba) kachada.

Veha okimna kegavvna da, karbena salleka leyachada (nusach acher yichuda) karbena uleyachada (davar acher valeasetapekaa) kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh mehahu tenana desalik, kahana deihu yemina, bekishshura deyichuda biruta, velevae beshirata. kalil da beda. hechala behechala, rucha berucha, ad demitchabberan beatrayyhu, shayyfa beshayyfa, lemeheve kolla kalil kachada kedka yeot.

Veha okimna dechad ishtelim kolla kachada, shayyfin illain betattain, keden, nishmeta illaa decholla, itarat, vealat bechullehu, venahir lecholla, vechullehu mitbarchan illain vetatain. vehahu dela ityeyda, vela al bechushevana, reuta dela itfas lealmin, keden kolla salik ad en sof, veitkashshar kolla bekishshura chada, uvasim, hahu reuta lego bego bistimu.

Nehiru denishmeta illaa, salleka lego bego, venahir lecholla. bego dehay nehiru, ail setimu demachashava, deihu kalil kolla, uvego lego, behahu reu demachashava, anhir veitbasam vetafis vela tafis, vesalleka (sefer acher hay reu) migo reu demachashava letafsa beh, vechad hay salik, nehiru diltatta tafis beh.

Vechen kolla, leitkashshera uleitmalleya uleitbarcha kolla kachada, kedka yeot. ucheden itkashshar da beda kadka amaran, hechalin behechalin, tattain beillain, raza dechar venukeba kachada, nehiru illaa, binhiru desatim veganiz yatir beh. vehahu deganiz, kalil bema deganiz yatir, ad deishtechach kolla kedka yeot, beyichuda chada.

Veal da, moshe hava yada lesaddera siddura demareh mikkol bene alma, kad itzterich learcha, arich. lekatztzera, katzar. kema (244 amud bet) deokimna, (Bamidbar 12:13) el na refa na lah. tanenan, man deorich bitzloteh veyistakkal beh, lesof ata lide keev lev. vetanenan, man deorich bitzloteh, yorchun yomoy.

Veraza demilla, man dearich baatar devae lekatztzera, ate lide keev lev, man lev. da hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 15:15) vetov lev mishte tamid. begin deihu atar devae lekatztzera, vela learcha beh, deha kolla kaim leella, uvae dela leamshacha leh, lekashshera leh bekishshura dilella, bela arichu lemeheve kolla chad beyichuda chad. vechevan deitkashar kachada, keden la bae learcha bearichu, uleitchanna betachanune. vechad arich baarichu, baatar deitzterich, kudesha berich hu kabbil tzeloteh, veda hu yekara dekudesha berich hu, begin deyichuda ditzlota ka mekashsher kishrin, veasge birchan leella vetatta.

Go hechala da, kayyeyma nekuda chada temirta, vehay nekuda ihi rucha, lokovla rucha achara illaa. vechad sharya rucha berucha, keden al da beda veihu chad, udevekuta chada. veitrechiv da beda lemeheve chad, kehay ilana dearkiv da beda veihu chad, zina bezineh. vavy man dearkiv zina bela zineh, keinnun bene aharon, devau learkava ilana beachara delav ihu zineh.

Uman dearkiv zina bezineh, veyada lekashshera kishra bekishreh, hechala behechaleh, darga bedargeh, da it leh chulaka bealma deate, kema deokimna. veal da, hay ihu shelimu decholla. vechad ishtelim da beda, veihu kolla chad ovada zina bezineh denafik mehay shelimu hahu ikre maase merkava.

Veraza da (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam, (Bereshit 48 amud bet) shem malle. veadam ihu ovada dehay merkava, dearkiv da beda, ovada dishlimu decholla, vechad ishtelim da beda, keden Adonai elohim, shem malle. zakkaa ihu man deyada lekashshera kishre mehemnuta. uleyachada yichuda kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, kema deitnehu shemahan kadishin illain, mitchabberin illen beillen, hachi ihu shema kadisha. itperash leella, veitperash letatta. shema da ihu leella, shema da ihu beemtzaita, shema da ihu letatta. Adonai deihu raza dishma kadisha, ihu chad. raza decholla. alma illaa, bistimu distimuta dealeh, deishtattef bahadeh, veihu chad. alma tattaa, bistimu deemtzaita, raza reticha kadisha illaa dealeh, veokimna. (sefer acher ta chaze raza dishma kaddisha da Adonai elohim shemma da ihu leella shemma da ihu beemtzaita shemma da ihu letatta. leella raza dealma deate bistimu distimuta dealeh veihu chad. letatta raza dealma tattaa vealma ilaa dealeh ishtattaf bahadeh veihu chad. beemtzaita beraza dirticha kaddisha ilaa veokimna)

Mehay gisa, 4 retichin nafkin, umehay gisa arba retichin nafkin, begin dechol chad vechad mitperash learba, kol reticha arba innun, kad mistakkelin dargin. vechen kullehu arba bearba, (ad denachtin darga letatta behahu atar deikre) beraza dishma kadisha deihu adonay, beinnun retichin dekayyme venatle bishma da, veinnun ikrun (zecharya 6) hare nechoshet, begin deit harim veit harim. it harim illain, (139 amud alef) veharim tattain. veinnun bitlat sitrin kayyme, venafke miggo zahav vachesef unechoshet.

Nechoshet letatta, begin deinnun retichin denafke migo alef dalet nun yod di bego hechala kadmaa, deinnun arba retichin denafkin migo innun teren ruchin yemina usemala, miggo livnat hassafir, (246 amud alef) kidkamran. illen teren ruchin dekaamrenan hatam, innun ikrun tere turim, veinnun (233 amud alef) hare nechoshet.

Meinnun tere ruchin deikrun hare nechoshet, nafke innun 4 retichin, demishtammeshe behahu shema (246 amud bet) dealef dalet, deishteka besandalfon, mareh deappaya. vechullehu shelichan al illen bealma, beraza desusevavn uretichin, begin deit reticha al susevavn, denatle lah.

Veda shema kadisha, itkelil beYod hei, kema deokimna, deitkelil alef dalet beYod hei, veihu yeahadonahi. (246 amud bet) veha ittemar, elohim la itkelil bishma achara, begin deit elohim chayyim, umehay, itpashat lechamma sitrin, vela itkenish, ella itpashat.

Shema dechalil kol shemahan, yod hei vav hei, beraza deatvavn tzerufa dishma kadisha, deveh hava yada kahana, letzarfa bechol sitroy, ad desalke shemahan bechamma sitrin, (Bereshit 9 amud alef) bearbein uteren gavvnin, beishtetachu devutzina dekardinuta, dehay ihu kalil kol shemahan.

Ushema da, kalil kol shemahan. 151 siman. beillen atvavn kelilan acharanin mitchabberan. venafke illen, veayyle illen. levatar kad itnete veitfashshat butzina dekardinuta, mitztarfe atvavn begavvav, veaale atvavn, venafke atvavn, beraza deillen tesha atvavn. veillen itmesaru lekadishe elyonin, lemehach beorcha deraza deatvavn. letzarfa yichuda dishmahan deatvavn, kema dehava yada kahana letzarfa shemahan, beatvavn reshiman.

(Yechezkel 1:8) vide adam mittachat kanfehem. kullehu yede adam, ha okimna, deinnun (nusach acher serafim) ruchin vechevavn veofannim. (keruvim vechayyot veofannim) kullehu begadpin, vidin techot gadpayyhu, lekabbela tzelotin, ulekabbela mare detiuveta. yede adam atrin veduchetin, lekabbela bene nasha, bitzlothon uvautehon, uleaftecha pitchin lekabbela lon, leyachada ulekashshera kishrin, ulemevad reutehon.

Veillen atrin veduchetin deikrun yede adam, dekayyme livni nasha, illen innun shemahan kadishin, deshalitin bechol darga vedarga, (begin) divhon alin bene nasha, bitzlotehon uvautehon, bechol tarin illain. uveda shaltin tattain leella. veraza da, (Tehillim 119:73) yadecha asuni vaychonnuni, veillen shemahan kadishin.

(Shemot 9:22) vayyomer Adonai el moshe nete et yadcha al hashshamayim. vechi hech yachil learama yedeh al shemayya. ella nete: archin. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 18:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad, meshichu milleella letata. yadcha: atrach. atra dedarga dilach, deat shaari begaveh, veda beraza dishma kadisha. vecholla illae vetatae, beraza dishmahan natle vekayyme. uvehu alin bene nasha lehechalin illain, velet man deyimche bidayyhu. zakkain innun deyadin lesadra yichuda demarehon kedka yeot, ulemehach beorach keshot, begin dela yitun beraza dimhemnuta.

Ta chaze, behechalin illen, it raza illaa go mehemnuta. vechullehu chevavn retichin, kullehu meshanyayn da min da, leitkallela illen beillen letav, leitakkena. vesimanich (Ester 2:9) vayshanneha veet naaroteha letov. beshiva hechalin illen, shelimu deella. kad ishtelim da beda, vealu tzelotin uvautin. deman deyada lesaddera lon, leatkena lon leella. kema deat amer (Ester 2:9) veet sheva hannearot haruyyot latet lah mibbet hammelech.

Hechala kadmaa. (Yeshayahu 45:7) yotzer or uvore choshech. nehiru deeven tava sefiru, deeven tava natzitz litren sitrin, kema (250 amud alef) deokimna limina velismala, or vechoshech. (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita, kullehu ofannim vegalgallim, mala haaretz kinyanecha vegomer. hammelech hameromam levaddo meaz shema kaddisha yeahadonahi, kelala dishma kaddisha, shelim bitre shemahan, veda hu salik baavira, umitnasse mimot olam.

Hechala tinyayna, el baruch gedol dea, orfaniel, (nusach acher raza atvavn zeirin) dechalil razin deatvavn zeirin dealfa beta. hacha innun dekamre kadosh uvaruch. vehacha ihu kedushsha, uvaruch kevod Adonai. hechala telitaa, lael baruch (46 amud bet) neimot yittenu.

Hechala reviaa hamechaddesh betuvo bechol yom tamid maase vereshit. begin dehacha mitgalgelin nehorin, vedinin dealma. man deihu lechayyim, mitchaddesh kemillekaddemin, leitkayyeyma bealma, binhora dimina, deikre el kidkamran.

Hechala chamishaa. hechala da ikre ahavat olam. veda ihu meshichu dirchimuta dehechala deikre ahava, veda hi ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai elohenu, baruch atta Adonai habbocher beammo yisrael beahava, beraza deel shadday.

Hechala shetitaa, emet veyatziv venachon vekayyaym. uvaenan dela leafseka ben hechalin illen. (leillen) deha bimshichu ditzlota ureuta mitchabberan kachada, veitkashsheran illen beillen, beraza dishmahan kadishin deshalitin bechol chad vechad.

Hechala sheviaa, adonay sefatay tiftach, raza derazin bilchishu, vela ishtema kala. hacha ihu reuta delibba, leitkavvna ulesalleka reuta mitatta leella, ad en sof, ulekashshera sheviaa bishviaa, (vecholla chad bechad) da beda (nusach acher mittatta leella) ulevatar, meella letatta, leamshacha birchan bechullehu almin, mimmekora dechayye, (nusach acher deihu sheviaa leillaa) deihu hechala sheviaa illaa (veda shechinta) biruta delibba, uvistimu deayynin, deraza deatvavn desheva shemahan illain kadishin.

Hechala sheviaa illaa da, deihu (225 amud alef) mekora dechayye, da ihu birchata kamayyta. veda ihu hechala kadmaa, sheruta decholla meella letatta, ulenatla sheviaa mittatta, leitchabbera da beda, sheviaa bishviaa. deha mehay diltatta, ayel man deayil, lehechala illaa.

Veda hu raza, (Bereshit 45 amud alef) baruch, rivuya dechullehu tattae, kelila bechevavn userafim veofannim, vechullehu hechalin rivuya deraza dekodesh hakkadashim, desharya begaveh bignizu, ucheden ikre baruch, bechol illen rivuyayn uvirchan, verazin deishtelimu ba.

Atta, ittura distimu deatvavn, kelala dechullehu 22 atvavn. veda hu at. Adonai dechalil lon meella, behay Adonai, vechanish lon begavih, veda ihu at Adonai. vechad ihi bishlimu behahu (236 amud bet) nahar deachid ba, salleka leitatra leella, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Ester 2:13) (225 amud bet) uvaze hannaara baa el hammelech, ucheden et kol asher tomar yinnaten lah. veda ihu raza baruch atta, uvae leitchavvna behay raza, ulekashshera reuta behay raza.
Adonai elohenu: da ihu kishshura veyichuda demalka illaa leella, behay, kad hannaara baa el hammelech et kol asher tomar yinnaten lah.

Velohe avotenu: da raza daavahan, levarcha lah. veda ihu raza, elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov. kema dehay naara la ishtevakat mittattae, hachi name la ishtevakat meavahan lealmin. ihu achidat behon (nusach acher lenatra lon valeateraa la) leatra lah.

Uvegin deitbarcha mikkol chad minnehon, bae leadkera lah al kol chad vechad. ulevatar yitkanneshun kullehu bechibbura chada, (sefer acher lego maar deima) umitattere bahadah, hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora, ha kullehu kachada, lesalleka leella bekadmita meella letatta vehasheta mittatta leella. leachlela lon bahadeh dechevan deamar hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora kullehu kelilan bah. ucheden, el elyon gomel chasadim tovim kone hakkol. veda kelala decholla.

Vezocher chasde avot, deishtahu bahadah (deishtechachan kachada) vealu bimaha, veitbarchun tamman. ulevatar shaari lon veafik lon kad innun itbarchan migavvav. uvehahi hishtachavaa deamar baruch atta Adonai magen avraham, hacha nafke kullehu bichlala, deha bimina kullehu mitbarchan kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, hechala sheviaa da, raza demalka illaa, umitatteran beh avahan kidkamran, veitkelilu beh. vead hasheta itkelilu, uvae leafaka lon, ihu hechala da, vechad afik lon mevarchan, (nusach acher mitbarchan) begin hay naara, keden ihi achidat behu, bechol innun birchan. veaf al gav deha itkelilu hechalin behechalin, hasheta itachidu beinnun birchan kachada, vechad amar melech ozer umoshia umagen, keden afik lon mevarchan.

Vehay, ihu chad hechala sheviaa, beraza dishma kadisha illaa, buchu. 'beracha 'vachesed 'koach 'umishfat, kelala raza (nusach acher deraza) (kolla) veraza da, hu raza (sefer acher deihi) deehye kelala decholla. begin deillen atvavn kelala decholla. begin deillen atvavn, afiku illen (sefer acher lon) denafku minnayyhu, kelala daavahan, veda ihu demitchabbera bahadayyhu, deikre beracha.

Kevan deamar baruch atta Adonai magen avraham, ha achidat birchan minnayyhu, beraza dehechala chamishaa ahava, deihu yemina, veihu chamishaa, leitkashshera birchimu devirchan dimina. vehachi itzterich, meella letata leitbarcha. bekadmita itkelalu hechala behechala kidkamran, vehasheta natle birchan leishtakkecha illen mikkadmat illen. veaf al gav deit denatil (sefer acher daatanetayf) bekadmita. kevan deishtechachu missitra dimina birchan, behechala chamishaa share leachada.

Ulevatar bistar semala, beraza da atta gibbor. vehay ihu chibbura atta vegibbor, teren dinin. vechevan deitmashchan birchan, itkelil berachame, veishtechach behahu sitra kolla kachada, veda hu mechayye metim somech noflim verofe cholim vechulei.

Veda ihu beraza dishma kadisha deikre achadtam, raza ihu beatvavn dishma deikre elohim. begin deillen atvavn sallekin leitattera leella, veafiku lehu illen leitkere behon, vesallekin leitattera leella elohim chayyim, vegara beatvavn, leachada bigriu. umehacha itpeshshat letatta, lenatla miggo illen atvavn acharanin, ulesalleka meillen atvavn, lishma deelohim.

Kevan deitmashchan atvavn bechamishaa ureviaa meella kidkamran, shaari veachid birchan meemtzaita dechola, mehechala shetitaa, veachid birchan behay uvehay. uvegin kach (becholla atta kadosh veitkelil) atta kadosh, itkelil atta bekadosh.

Veshimcha kadosh, kevan deamar atta kadosh, amay veshimcha kadosh, hayeynu shem, hayeynu atta. ella ha tanenan, bechol atar deishtechach yichuda vekishshura, baenan (133 amud alef) kedushsha, vetosefet kedushsha, vehahu tosefet ikkara hu yatir mikkolla. uvegin kach, bechullehu ketiv atta, vela yatir, vehacha behay atar, amar kedushsha, vetosefet kedushsha. atta kadosh kedushsha, veshimcha kadosh tosefet kedushsha. ukedoshim bechol yom: ellu shear kedoshin illain, di bechol hechala vehechala, demitkaddeshe mehay tosefet. begin dikdushsha kamayyta ihi lah, vetosefet kedushsha, leitkadsha kol innun shear dekamran.

Ulevatar itkadsha kolla meella, umichullehu avahan, itkeshar bekishshura chada, vehayeynu baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh. hacha kolla kishura chada, begin deamar baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh. veal da ikre tzerora vekishshura decholla beyichuda chad. zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lesaddera shevache demareh baatar deitzterich. ad hacha, devekuta uvirkan ukedushsha kachada baavahan.

Mikkan ulehala, kayymin sheeltin uvautin. sheruta devae bar nash lemishal, leminda bemillin demareh, begin lemechoze tiuveteh legabbeh, vela itperash minneh. begin devae bar nash leishtattefa bikdushsha dishma kaddisha illaa, leitattera beh, veihu shema devirkaan vekiddushin, kuzu. raza dishma kaddisha Adonai deihu kaddish bikdushsha. veillen atvavn (acharanin) appiku minneh hane atvavn acharanin, chibbura dehane, kechibbura didchar benukeba. vehane kaddishin illain, raza dikdushsha.

Illen atvavn acharanin ikrun tal. tal hashshamayim. raza dechushebana deatvavn dileh, begin dehacha letatta, kayyman kol millin bechushebana, vela (15 amud bet) chushebana, ella lesihara. uvegin kach bae leitkashshera bikdushsha demareh, vela yitperash bar nash minneh. vechad shail, sheruta disheltin leminda lemareh, leachazaa detiuvete legabbeh. mikkan ulehala, yitperash zeer zeer, vayishal sheeltoy ma deitzterich leshaala.

Vechol sheeltoy yehon, levatar disadder siddura da dekamran. kegavvna da, kol sheeltoy yehon betachanunim uvautin lekamme mareh, vela yatzdik (sefer acher yarchik) garmeh minneh. zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lesaddera siddura da, lemehach beorach meshar, kadka chaze.
Kegavvna deitachada eshsha bemayya, umaya beeshsha. darom betztzafon, vetzafon bedarom. mizrach bemmaarav, umaarav bemizrach. hachi name itkashar kolla kachada, veyichuda ishtelim da beda.

Vechol innun deyadin lesaddera tzelothon kedka yeot, leitkallela hanni hechalin illen beillen, uleitkashshera da beda. hay bar nash itkashar behu, vekariv leh leitkallela behu. sheelta shail veyahiv leh. zakkaa chulakeh behay alma, uvealma deate.

Batar desiyyem sheeltin vegufa shelim bechol sitrin bechedva delibba veihu shail vesiyyem sheeltin. yehdar leamshacha birchan vechedvavan letatta, beraza dehechala telitaa, leamshacha letatta, veda hu retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael. hay ihu (nusach acher begin) demaamadot innun samchin degufa. sheruta letatta min gufa teren yarchin, ad demate levirkin.

Veillen innun raza demaamadot, dekayyme al karbena. vehacha ihu raza sheruta ditren yarchin milleella, ad birchin, chibbura dinviim. umarot, beraza deatvavn dishma kadisha, deikre (499 403 302) hashetafa. deihu raza dishma deikre tzevaot. da salik, veda nachit. da neviim, veda marot.
