Vehacha ihu raza illaa divrayyte dekamran, vechad mate inish lebirkin, yichra baruch atta Adonai hamachazir shechinato letziyyon, veha hacha ahadru berayyte (257 amud bet) lematnitin veitbarchan kachada.

Hechala tinyayna letatta, deitpekadu beh nishmatin lesalleka, leitchazaa bechezu (258) dechelma. modim, leachrea birchin, leodaa al nishmatin, kidkamran al nishmotenu happekudot, (kevan daashateayl mimmareh) (sefer acher hechala tinyayna leamshacha birchan letatta modim anachnu lecha vehay hechala ihu deitpekadu beh nishmatin lesalleka leitchazaa bechezu dechelma. hacha bae bar nash laakareaa birchin leodaa al nishmatin veda hu al nishmotenu happekudot) ad demate lehattov shimcha ulecha nae lehodot.

Veda hu go raza dishma kaddisha, deikre bam bemuchan. da ikre el elohim, deihu beraza illaa. (yehoshua 22:22) el elohim Adonai hu yodea. kelala deillen atvavn acharanin denafke minnayyhu, (davar acher vehacha ihu raza chada dechullehu yarchin mevarchin) uletatta, raza dechelma. raza lehahu atar leaala behu nishmatin. uvaenan leamshacha behane birchan, begin leashkecha nayycha behay alma, uvealma deate.

Hechala tattaa letatta, sim shalom tova uveracha. hacha ihu kelala deshalom. shalom leella, shalom letatta, shalom lechol sitrin, shalom befamalya dilella, shalom befamalya diltatta, vehechala da ihu pamalya diltatta. (sefer acher deihu hechala diltatta veda bechibbura vechulei) bechibbura chada befamalya (nusach acher baheykelah) dilella. umehacha nagid lechol innun tattae dilvar.

Vehacha itkelil veishtelim kolla kachada, ella vetatta, binhiru chada, leishtallema shem male, Adonai elohim. shem da deihu shalem, bechol innun hechalin, bechol innun nehorin illain, lemeheve kullehu chad. (sim shalom tova uveracha)

Hay bar nash, kad ishteil mehechala da lenafka levar. yeshavve garmeh, keman denafik mechavruta demalka, umiggo hechaleh, veyamich garmeh kameh. aval yechede garmeh, deha kadmaa ihu, lenatla itra dimshichu devirkaan denagdin miyichuda demareh. da ihu bar, deihu mehechala demalka. deha behay shaata deka nafik mikkamme malka, vecholla kashir bechol hane sitrin, bekishshura (116 amud alef) deyichuda, uvirkan, ukedushsha, vetosefet kedusha. kudesha berich hu kare lefamalya dilella, veamar lon, ketovu lehay bar nash pelanya, meinnun deikrun choshve shemo.

Man choshve shemo. innun dimchashsheve umechavvnin beraza dishmeh, leyachada hechalin behechalin, lekashshera kishrin, uleyachada kullehu beyichuda chada. veillen innun choshve shemo, kema deat amer (Malachi 3:16) ulechoshve shemo. keden achtivu leh, veitreshim veishtemoda leella, (veitreshim) veishtelim ihu leella vetatta.

Uman dekariv kame mareh, vetzalle tzeloteh, vela ashlim yichuda, vela chayish al yekara demareh, lekashshera kishrin kidkamran, tav leh dela ivre. vekudesha berich hu amar (Yirmeyahu 22:30) kitvu et haish hazze ariri gever la yitzlach beyamav. veda ihu (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo.

Hacha ishtelim kolla leella vetatta, raza dishma kaddisha shallita leella. matzfetz matzfetz. (Shemot la) Adonai Adonai el rachum vechannun. hacha ihu raza dishma kaddisha da, leitkaddesha beatvoy beve asara, veatvavn acharanin bikdushsha dichiday bitzlota. batar desiyyem, kaim al ragloy, (nusach acher lechappara) leodaa (120 amud bet) al chovoy, begin dela yehe pitra defuma lesitra achara, leastaa leh, veitkafya kameh. veyekum bekiyyumeh leitbarcha mibbe malka.

Vezakkaa chulakeh man deitkaddash behay gavvna bitzlota kidkamran, vekashar kishrin, veyiched yichudin, veyitkevavn becholla kedka yeot, vela yiste limina velismala. tzeloteh la ahdar berekanayya. kudesha berich hu gazir veihu mevatel. al da ketiv (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha. it leh chulaka bealma den, uvealma deate. ((Ester 2:14) beerev hi baa hayeynu)

Ketiv (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vegomer mehahu ribbuya devirkaan, ukedushsha, vetosefet kedushsha deka natla. kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:27) velaerev yechallek shalal, difligat chulaka lecholla, vaafillu lesitra achara chulaka bilchodaha.

Veraza da, raza livne mehemnuta. chulaka desitra achara misava, kol innun chovin, vechol innun chatain, dehahu bar nash dekashar kishrin deyichuda, deitvadda alayyhu, kullehu sharyayn aleh desitra achara. veinnun chulaka veachasanta desitra achara misava. vei la ode aleh, ishtechach mekatrega veyachil leh.

Vei ode al kol chovoy, behahi tzelota, dekashir kishrin deyichuda, veitbarchan illae vetattae. umehahu chulaka desitra achara, kol innun chovin vechattain deode alayyhu, natla lon lechulakeh. veraza da sair. dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:21) vehitvadda alav et kol avonot vegomer, uchetiv venasa hassair vegomer, da hu chulakeh veadveh veachasanteh. vei hahu bar nash tav lesarchane dechovoy, vavy leh, dechullehu natil lon mehahu sitra, beal karcheh dehahu sitra. umiggo denatil lon mehay sitra beal karcheh dehahu sitra, keden avish leh, veithappech aleh mekatrega, vekatrig leh. vechad ode aloy, natil lon hahu sitra achara, veihu adveh vechulakeh.

Veraza da, hachi name karbena, devae leodaa al hahu karbena, kol chovoy vechetoy, lemehav chulaka leman deitzterich. karbena kolla lesitra da chulaka dekudesha, vereuta dekudesha. ulesitra da, hahu chulaka deinnun chovin, vechattain deityeyhivu behodaa al hahu bisra dekarbena. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem vegomer. ki gechalim atta chote vegomer, vesimanich (Ester 5:5) yavo hammelech vehaman el hammishte. zakkaa ihu man deyada archeh lemehach beorach keshot.

Vechol man dela yada lesaddera shevacha demareh, tav leh dela ivre. begin deitzterich tzelota deihu shelama leella. (begin deitzterich tzelota) miggo machashava, ureuta delibba, vekala, umilla desifvavn. lemebad shelimu vekishshura veyichuda leella, kegavvna deihu leella. kegavvna denafka shelimu meella letatta, hachi itzterich mittatta leella, lekashshera kishra kadka yeot.

Raza lechavrayyay deyehachun beorach meshar, machashava. vereuta. vekala. umilla. illen arba mekashrin kishrin. levatar keshiru kishrin kullehu kachada, itavidu kullehu reticha chada, leashraa alayyhu shechinta, veitavidu kullehu levatar arbaa samchin leitattera behu, ushechinta istemich alayyhu, bechol innun kishrin illain.

Machashava appik reuta, (reuta appik kolla) reuta denafik miggo machashava, appik kala deishtema, vehahu kala deishtema, salik lekashshera kishrin mittatta leella, hechalin tattain beillain. kala deihu kashir kishrin umashich birchan meella letatta bilchishu, samich illen arbaa samchin: machashava. ureuta. kala. umilla. semichu besiuma dekishshura, atar decholla itkashar beh kachada, veitavidu kullehu chad.

Zakkaa ihu bar nash dekashar kishrin demareh, vesamich semichin kedka yeot, veitkavavn bechol hane millin dekamran. zakkaa ihu behay alma, uvealma deate. ad hacha ishtachlalu hechalin besitra dikdushsha.
Zohar, Pekudei 53: Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Hoshea 6:7) vehema keadam avru verit sham bagdu vi. man yegale afar meenecha adam kadmaa, dekudesha berich hu pakid lach pikkuda chada, vela yachilat lekayyeyma ba. begin deitpattit al millin bishin, deaste lach hahu chivya bisha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum. uvegin kach, itpattit avatreh, vegarmat mita legarmach, ulechol innun toladin denafku minach. ta chaze, dechol man deitpatta avatreh venachit legabbeh beriga chada, yitavid legabbeh.

Ta chaze, david hava kiuma naitz bimkora demayin navin, vechad itdachya leara achara, vetzarin leh, ulefum tzareh itdachya meara kaddisha. af al gav denachit middargoy ledarga tattaa, kam bekiyyumeh, vela al lesitra achara, veistemar minneh. ma ketiv (Shmuel 1 20:3) veulam chay Adonai veche nafshecha ki kefesa beni uven hammavet. deha nachit bedargoy, ad dehava beh hay shiura. vezakkaa chulakeh, man deistemar mehahu sitra bisha, umikkol dargin dehahu sitra, demishtakkeche bealma.

Dechamma sitrin vedargin it leyetzer hara: nachash akallaton. satan. malach hammavet. yetzer hara. veha ukemuha. deaf al gav devishmahan illen ikre, sheva shemahan innun leh: satan. tame. sone. even michshol. arel. ra. tzefoni. illen innun sheva shemahan, lokovel sheva dargin dehechalin dileh, dechullehu missitra misava kidkamran. lokovel illen shiva shemahan, innun deikre behu gehinnam, atar deittedanu beh chayyayvayya dealma. veillen innun: bor. shachat. duma. tit hayyaven. sheol. tzalmavet. eretz tachtit. kol illen shiva madorin degehinnam, lokovel illen sheva shemahan, deit leh leyetzer hara.

Veha okimna, dichmma deit dargin vehechalin listar kedushsha, hachi name listar misava. vechullehu mishtakkeche veshalte bealma, bistar (sefer acher semala) misava. shiva hechalin innun, deinnun lokovel shiva shemahan, deikre behu gehinnam (yetzer hara). vechullehu (leastaa bisha) kayyme ledayyeyna, ulesaava, leinnun chayyayve alma dedabbeke behu, vela istammeran archayyhu minneh, kad innun behay alma.

Deha man deate leitdakkea behay alma, besitra dedachya, medakkein leh, behahu atar deikre raza dimhemnuta. dechamma dargin innun, vechamma memanan, dechullehu kayymin lekarva livne nasha lefulechaneh dekudesha berich hu, uledakkea leh. uman deate leistaava, mesaavin leh behay sitra achara deihu misava. deha kama dargin, vechamma memanan, kullehu kayyme lesaava lon livne nasha.

Man deyikrav behu, veate leitmashshecha batar hahu sitra bisha, aleh ketiv, (Tehillim 89:49) mi gever yichye velo yire mavt yemallet nafsho vegomer. man ihu bar nash deitbere bealma dela yechome mota, hahu dechol alma itmashshechan avatreh. deha behahu zimna deate bar nash lemehav chushebana kame mareh, ad la yippuk mehay alma, chame leh, veha okimna.

Veillen shiva hechalin, deinnun shiva madorin laggehinam. teresar yarchin ikrun, begin deha kema deit listar mehemnuta teresar yarchin, dargin kaddishin, hachi name it lesitra achara da teresar yarchin, dechayyayvayya itdanu behu, venishmeta dilhon ittedanat behu. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deitmanan raglayyhu minnayyhu behay alma, vela mitkarve letarayyhu, begin leishtezava minnayyhu behahu alma.
Zohar, Pekudei 8: Ribbi yose veribbi yitzchak havo azle bearcha, amar ribbi yose, vadday dekudesha berich hu itree beh bivtzalel laavidat mashkena, yattir mikkol yisrael, amay. amar leh, shema garim, veha okmuha, dekudesha berich hu shavve shemahan beara, leitattera (sefer acher leitteara) behu, ulemebad behu avidta bealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 46:9) asher sam shammot baaretz.

Amar leh, raza ihu hacha, yehuda missetar semala hava, veahdar veitdabbak bimina. veal da, besitra da itavid mashkena, share missetar semala, veitdabbak bistar yemina, ulevatar itkelil da beda, veitavid kolla yemina. kegavvna da orayyta, share missemala, veitdabbak bimina, veitkelil da beda, veitavid kolla yemina. reuven shara mimina, vesata lismala, venatlu immeh innun shear shevatin, deinnun semala, begin deshari mimina vesata lismala.

Yehuda shara missemala, vesata limina, shara missemala, begin deate missetar semala, veitdabbak bimina, umashkena besitra da itavid. share mistar semala, veitdabbak bistar yemina, veal da, betzalel ihu deate missitreh, aved mashkena veittakkan legabbeh. veha ukemuha, dekudesha berich hu itree beh, uvarir leh mikkolla laavidta da.

Veyahav leh chachma utevuna vadaat, kema deukemuha. begin deimmeh hava bekadmita sachletanu delibba, dichtiv uvelev kol chacham lev natatti chachma. begin dekudesha berich hu la yahiv chachmeta, ella leman deit beh chachmeta, veukemuha chavrayyay veittemar. vechen kegavvna da betzalel. ribbi shimon amar, betzalel shemeh garim leh, veal chachmateh ikre hachi, veraza demilla betzalel, betzel el.

Patach veamar, (Shir hashshirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar ken dodi vegomer. betzillo: hayeynu betzalel, deihu atkin mashkena, veavid leh. dichtiv chimmadti veyashavti. demashkena chamida ihu lemetav beh, deihu avid chimmuda lichneset yisrael, ucheneset yisrael yatva betzilla deel. veda ihu betzalel.

Ufiryo matok lechikki, deda (214 amud bet) ihu deavid perin tavin bealma, dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:9) mimmenni peryecha nimtza. man hu peri. illen innun nishmathon detzaddikayyay, deinnun ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu. dehahu nahar denafik meeden, ihu appik vezarik nishmatin lealma, veinnun perin dekudesha berich hu, ubbegin kach piryo. da ihu kidkaamran.

Betzillo: da hu betzalel. veal da tikkuna demashkena al yeda divtzalel hava. ubbegin kach uvetzalel ben uri ben chor. ben uri, da nehora deshimsha denafik. ben uri, da yemina. ben chor, da ihu semala. ben uri ben chor, (sefer acher ben chor ben chore) veal da ishtelim beh dina dekudesha berich hu beovada deegla.

(Shemot 38:24) kol hazzahav heasuy. mehahi shaata deyahavu leh yisrael, hava asuy veittakkan mikkadmat dena, bechol melechet hakkodesh, kol hahu dahava, itavid veittakkan bechol melechet hakkodesh. may taama. begin divchol darga vedarga, hava ittakkan beh dahava. delet shelimu ella rachame vedina, veal da dahava hava azil bechol melechet hakkodesh, bechol hahi avidta deikre kodesh, hava azil ba dahava, dahava becholla.

Ribbi abba ribbi yose veribbi chizkiyya havo yatvin velaan beorayyta, amar leh ribbi chizkiyya leribbi abba, ha chamenan dekudesha berich hu itree bedina becholla, leitarva da beda, veihu arich dina bechayyayve alma, i ihu itere bedina, amay salik leh mechayyayvayya. amar leh, kama turin itakkeru bemilla da, aval kama millin galle butzina kaddisha behay.

Veta chaze, dina dekudesha berich hu itree beh, ihu dina barir, ihu dina (58 64 amud alef) deittear rechimu vechedva. aval chayyayvayya kad innun bealma, kullehu dina dezuhama. kullehu dina dela itree beh kudesha berich hu kelal. veal da, la bae leitarva dina kaddisha bedina misava dezuhama, ad deihu ishtetze miggarmeh, uleovada leh min alma deate, vehahu dina dezuhama deveh ihu ovid leh mealma.
Zohar, Yitro 28: (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha. rabbi chiyyay patach, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden vegomer. venahar, da neviu demabbua, denafik tadir vela pasak. uminnahara demabbua da, itshakya kol ginta deeden. vehahu nahara demabbua kaddisha, ikre av. may taama. mishshum deihu nevia leittezana leginta.

Rabbi abba amar, eden mammash ikre av. mishshum dehay eden, mishtechach mehahu atar, deikre ayin. uvegini kach, ikre av. veha ukimna, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, veikre av. kema (ayyen sof hassefer 13 mispar livnat hassappir) deat amar, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu.

Rabbi elazar amar, kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. et avicha, et dayyka, leachlela shechinta (davar achar ilaa). rabbi yehuda amar, kabbed et avicha, setam. veet immecha, setam. deha kolla hava beminyayna. et, lerabbot kol ma dilella vetatta.

Rabbi yosi amar, hay deamar rabbi abba, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, shappir. deha olifna, hahu detamir vela it beh sheruta, karenan hu. meatar (Vayikra 2, amud alef 78, 290 amud alef) desheruta ishtechach, karenan atta. veikre av. vecholla chad. berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya amen.

Rabbi chizkiyya amar, vadday kolla chad. kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. deha tenan, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, hahu atar deikre banim. uvegine kach setima demilla, kabbed et avicha veet immecha, leachlela kolla, dilella vetatta. Rabbi yitzchak amar, leachlela beh rabbeh, dehu ail leh lealma deate. amar rabbi yehuda, bichlala dekudesha berich hu have.

Tana, behane chamesh amiran, kalil kolla. behane chamesh amiran, itgelifu chamesh acharanin, vadday chamesh go chamesh. ha ketzad. anochi Adonai elohecha, (84 amud bet) lokovel lo tirtzach. detanenan, (amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yehuda) teren illen, bichlala chada itteklilan, deman dekatil, azir demuta vetzalma demareh. dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv (yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam.

Amar Rabbi chiyyay, ketiv (bareasheytet) sofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech vegomer, (shofech dam haadam) man deshafich dama, keillu azir demuta vetzalma dilella, kelomar, la azar demuta da, ella demuta achara, mashma dichtiv shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech. baadam illaa, mate hay pegimuta, mehahu dama deoshid. may taama. mishshum ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uvegin kach, ha beha talya.

Lo yihye lecha, lokovel lo tinaf da meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, deitreshim beh bevar nash. uveda, kamma vechamma chovin vegazrin veonashin, talyayn. uman dimshakker behay, meshakker beh bemalka, dichtiv, (Hoshea 5:7) baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu. uchetiv lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem, veha beha talya.
Lo tissa lokovel lo tignov. uchetiv (Mishlei 29:24) cholak im gannav sone nafsho alla yishma velo yaggid. vadday ha beha talya, deha gannava leda izdaman, leumaa beshikra. man deavid da, avid da.

Zachor et yom hashshabbat, lokovel lo taan vereacha ed shaker. deamar Rabbi yosi, shabbat sahaduta ikre. uvae bar nash lesahada al ha dichtiv ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai vegomer. veshabbat kelala (nusach acher sahaduta) decholla. veamar Rabbi yosi, may dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, kema deat amar (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, uman deashid shikra, meshakker beshabbat, dehi sahaduta dikshot, uman dimshakker beshabbat, meshakker beorayyta kulla. ubbegin kach, ha beha talya.

Kabbed et avicha, lokovel lo tachmod eshet reecha. veamar Rabbi yitzchak, kabbed et avicha, avicha mammash. deha man dechamid itteta, veolid bar, hahu bar okir leachara, dela avuy. uchetiv kabbed et avicha vegomer, lo tachmod bet reecha, sadehu. uchetiv hacha, al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. hahu deyahav lach, yehe dilach, velo tachmod achara. vadday ha beha talya.

Veillen chamesh kadmae, kelilan chamesh acharanin. uvegine kach, (Devarim log) mimino esh dat lamo. decholla itavid yemina. veal da, bachamishsha kalin orayyta ityeyhivat. amar Rabbi yehuda, kullehu havo chamesh go chamesh. lokovlehon chamishsha chumeshe tora.

Tane Rabbi elazar, beillen eser amiran, itgelifu kol pikkude orayyta, gezirin veonashin. dachya umesaava. anfin vesharashin. ilanin unetiin. shemayya veara. yamma utehome. deha orayyta shema dekudesha berich hu havi, ma shema dekudesha berich hu itgelif beeser amiran, uf orayyta itgelifa beeser amiran. illen eser amiran innun shema dekudesha berich hu. veorayyta kolla shema chad have, shema kaddisha dekudesha berich hu mammash.

Zakkaa chulakeh, deman dezache bah. man dezache beorayyta, zache bishma kaddisha. (dekudesha berich hu mammash) Rabbi yosi amar, bekudesha berich hu mammash zache, (sefer acher ucheneset yisrael) deha hu ushemeh chad hu, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin amen.

rashi: Baanosh letz yechkam peti. al yede yissure halletzim happetaim mitchakkemim veshavim bitshuva:
targum: Betukkeh dimmikina nechkam shavra uvesucheltanuteh dechakkima yisav yediata:

rashi: Mezare reshaim. paro vechelo (Shemot 14:28):
Melech chacham. hakkadosh baruch hu:
Vayyashev alehem ofan. galgal middatam heshiv alehem, "vaynahagehu bichvedut" (Shemot 14:25) keneged "vehachebed et libbo" (Shemot 8:11):
targum: Mevadar lerashie malka chakkima umehappech alehon gilgela:

rashi: Et haedut. halluchot:
Vayyaasu bene yisrael. et hammelacha kechol asher tzivva Adonai vegomer:
ohc: Vattechel kol avodat vegomer. perush, lo hem killu, sheim haya Adonai metzavve od baavodato yitbarach yaasu bene yisrael bechol avvat nafsham, ella shekkalta hammelacha asher tzivva Adonai.

Od yirtze beamro vattechel, letzad shehaya bah melachot shennaasu meatzman, shehi menora sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 95) shennaaset meatzmah, laze lo kinna hakkol alehem, ki yesh chelek bammelacha shehu lo naasa ella hakkaa bekurenas vehi meatzmah kalta.
Od yirmoz al derech amro (tehillim 84:3) "nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi lechatzrot Adonai", ki asu kol haavoda chashuka uchelilat yofi.

Vayyaasu bene yisrael vegomer. vahagam shello asa ella betzalel vechachme lev, shelucho shel adam kemoto ucheillu kol yisrael asu. vahagam shello matzinu sheasa betzalel ella bemaamar Adonai velo hem shelachuhu, af al pi chen hare hiskimu alav.

Od nire ki kan asa hakkatuv machberet hakkelalut bekiyyum hattora, vehera ki bene yisrael yezakku ze laze, vehattora nittena lehitkayyem bichlalut yisrael, kol echad yaase hayyecholet shebbeyado vizakku ze laze. veulay ki laze ramaz beamro (Vayikra 19:18): "veahavta lereacha kamocha", perush, letzad shehu kemotcha, ki bishlomo yetiv lecha uveemtzauto atta mashlim shelemutecha, veim ken eno acher ella atta atzmecha ucheechad mechalakecha.

Uvaze matzanu nachat ruach, ki Adonai tzivva 613 mitzvot, umin hannimna sheyyimmatze adam echad sheyyeshno bekiyyum kullam. veze lecha haot: kohen velevi veyisrael venashim – yesh mitzvot ase bakkohanim sheen metziut leyisrael laasotam, veyesh mitzvot leyisrael sheenam bakkohanim, vechen balviyyim, vechen bannashim. uma metziut yesh leyachid lekayyemam lehashelim tikkun lirmch evarav veshs gidav asher yechavvenu lahem? ella vadday shettitkayyem hattora bemachberet hakkelalut veyizku ze mizze. vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv kan vayyaasu bene yisrael kechol asher tzivva Adonai – kinna lechullam yachad maase kullam, hagam shemmehem heviu hannedava, mehem asu melacha, yomar al kelalutam sheasu hakkol. vesamach maamar ze limlechet habbegadim asher asaum yechidim miyyisrael, lehaircha ki al perat ze yomar sheasauhu bene yisrael been hevdel. umeatta kol echad miyyisrael hevi kol 18 minim shebbannedava veasa kol hammelachot haamurot.

Kechol asher vegomer. nitkavven baze lehasir hachashad mehem, ki yire haroe shetztzivva Adonai al hammishkan venaasa vekippeluhu shelosha chodashim (Shemot Rabba 52,2), yomar ki hayta sibba mitztzad hammaase shehaya bo davar bilti hagun o sheyyisrael ikkevu davar mikkol haamur bemitzvato, laze amar vattechel vegomer vayyaasu bene yisrael kechol. uma taam himtin hakkadosh baruch hu ad chodesh harishon shehu chodesh hammeshubbach shennikra rishon, vehu amro bigmar hammelacha (Shemot 40:2) "beyom hachodesh harishon takim" vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Shemot Rabba sham) letzad shennitbasser avraham beyitzchak.

Asher tzivva vegomer ken asu. taam amro asu velo hispik bemaamar "vayyaasu", ulay ki heela alehem hakkatuv shekkiyyemu kol ma shetztzivva Adonai et moshe battora, veze shiur hakkatuv vayyaasu bene yisrael kechol vegomer haamur bainyan, uvaze heericham hakkatuv keillu kechol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe kechol hattora ken asu, uvaze nisraf venifzar efro shel chet haegel.

rashi: Ner Adonai nishmat adam. hanneshama shebbekirbo meida alav baddin (Pesikta rabbati 8):
targum: Sheraga delaha nishmeta divne nasha uvatzya chulehon gavya dichresa:

rashi: Vayyakter alav ketoret. shacharit vearvit, kemo shenneemar babboker babboker behetivo et hannerot vegomer (Shemot 30):

Leene chol bet yisrael bechol masehem. bechol massa shehayu nosim, haya heanan shochen bammakom asher yachanu sham; mekom chaniyyatan af hu karuy massa, vechen vayyelech lemassaav (Bereshit 13), vechen elle mase (Bamidbar 33), lefi shemmimmekom hachaniyya chazru venasu, lechach nikreu chullan massaot:
Machshevot charutz. adam yashar hammithallech beemet uvemishpat charutz:
Ach lemotar. lehatzelacha ulerevach baot:
Vechol atz. dochek et hashshaa:
targum: Machshevata degavyan leyuteraga verigla dimsarhava lechuserana:

rashi: Vesakkota al haaron. leshon haggana, shehare mechitztza hayta:
Veet paare hammigbaot. tiferet hammigbaot – hammigbaot hammefoarot:
Maskil tzaddik. tzaddiko shel olam, hu hakkadosh baruch hu, noten lev lehacherit bet rasha, kegon zecher amalek (Shemot 17:14):
targum: Mittakkel tzadika beveteh derashia umetaltel rashiaya bevishta:

rashi: Latzeket. ketargumo leattacha:
Et adne hakkodesh. shel karshe hammishkan, shehem 48 kerashim velahen 96 adanim, veadne happarochet arbaa, hare mea, vechol shear haadanim nechoshet katuv bahem:
Vetzippa rashehem. shel ammudim mehen, shebbechullan ketiv vetzippuy rashehem vachashukehem kasef:
ohc: Veet haelef usheva vegomer. perush, hannisharim, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Shemot Rabba 51,5) sheshshechacham, ucheshezzachar otam amar "veet haelef" vegomer hem mimma sheasa vavim vegomer.

Vehinne lehassovrim mehachachamim (even Ezra al Shemot 25:3) ki lo haya kesef benidvat hammishkan zulat machatzit hashshekel, yitbaer amro veet haelef al ze hadderech: lefi shemmatzinu shetztzivva Adonai bitrumat hakkesef machatzit hashshekel, uvechol melechet hammishkan lo matzinu shetztzivva Adonai maase kesef zulat haadanim vehavvavin vachashukehem, uveer baadanim shetztzarich kikkar laaden, vehavvavin lo hodia Adonai shiuran veshiur chashukehen. laze nitchakkem betzalel vechillek hannishar mehaadanim vaasaan vavin, shehagam shello tzivva Adonai shiuran, mimma shennatan shiur laadanim hiskilu ki havvavin vachashukehem yihyu mehannishar. velaze amar veet haelef vegomer asa vavim, perush shechillek hassach lavvavin. vein hachi nammi im haya nishar yoter o pachot haya mechallek hannishar. veim haya omer hakkatuv "vayyaas vavin" vegomer, yihye nishma ki neemar mippi el elyon shiur ze, velo chen hu, ella mikkelalan shel devarim hevin kannizkar.

Vedati enah kisvara zo, ki vadday ki kesef acher haya bitrumat hammishkan millevad habbeka laggulgolet, ki mikra male dibber hakkatuv bevayyakhel (Shemot 35:24): "kol merim terumat kesef unechoshet", uvefasuk ze lo yatzdiku divre rabbi avraham ibben ezra sheyyishshev befasuk (Shemot 25:3) "vezot hatteruma", vehammaskil yavin. veyitbaer amro veet haelef al derech ma shepperashnu befasuk (Shemot 38:24) "kol hazzahav" vegomer, perush, shello nechsar beemtzaut hahattacha uferate hammelacha, shehagam sheasa kamma perate melacha bemaase kamma vavin vachashukehen, af al pi chen hammispar atzmo bishlemut haya bavvavin velo nechsar mimmennu kelum, vehu amro veet haelef vegomer asa vavim, vehaven:

rashi: Poal otzarot. leharebot hon. bilshon shaker:
Hevel niddaf vegomer. mokshe (0 mevakkeshe) mavet hem lo:
targum: Mabedanuta desimata belishana deshikra veyitchabbelun veyinatterun ilen devayan lemota:

rashi: Yegorem. yagur otam:
targum: Dichuna derashie yaalinun vela tzavyan deyabedun dina:

rashi: Kol derech ish yashar beenav vetochen. umone:
targum: Kulhon archateh degavra teritzan inun beappoy velaha metaken libbeh:

rashi: Vayyifros et haohel. hen yeriot haizzim:
ohc: Kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe. hutzrach lomar et moshe velo hispik lomar "kaasher tzivva Adonai" vehaddavar yadua ki oto tzivva Adonai? kavvanat hakkatuv hu lehodia shehattora meida al hammaase shello haya bo shinnuy mehammitzva, veshiur amro "kaasher" hu al gufo shel maase, veim haya omer "kaasher tzivvahu Adonai" haya benishma shechozer al haose sheasa kaasher tzivvahu, vehaven. vetaam kefel haddavar bechol perat uferat, lehareot shekkol perat hu chashuv mitzva bifne atzmo verauy leamer alav levaddo "tzivva Adonai et moshe".

rashi: Gole sod holech rachil ulefote sefatav. hamedabber chalakot lefattotcha ulehassitcha:
targum: Degale raza achal kuretza uleman dimshargag besifvateh la titchalet:

rashi: Rum enayim. gassut haruach:
Urechav lev. chafetz lemallovt taavat libbo, hu nir shel reshaim – charishutam umachshevotam hu chattatam:
targum: Ramut ayne uvee libba usheraga derashie lecheta:

ohc: Paamon verimmon. hutzrach lichtov ze shello tavin sheyyachol laasot shenayim o shelosha paamonim betoch shenayim o shelosha rimmonim, vekore ani bahem "betoch harimmonim". laze amar paamon verimmon, perush shello yaase shene paamonim verimmon, vechazar lomar paamon verimmon ba lishlol shello yaase shene rimmonim lechol paamon veyihye kol paamon bishne rimmonim, velo taale rimmon shebbimino shel paamon ze lismolo shel paamon habba acharav, laze amar paam sheniyya paamon verimmon, perush, samuch lerimmon shel paamon rishon yihye paamon sheni, vehaven:

rashi: Vayvarech otam moshe. amar lahem yehi ratzon shettishre shechina vemaase yedechem, vihi noam Adonai elohenu alenu vegomer, vehu echad mi mizmorim shebbitfilla lemoshe (sifra):
ohc: Vehinne asu vegomer ken asu. taam shechazar lomar paam sheniyya ken asu, ki amro "vehinne asu" nimshechet lemala "vayyar vegomer vehinne hi asuya", perush guf hammaase, vehakkavvana baze shello haya shiur bazzeman veraa shehinne asauhu bizman muat.
Od yirtze beamro asu otah leshon tikkun, shettikkenu otah kammitztarech. veod modia shehiskil bah sheasauha kaasher tzivva Adonai bifrate hammishpat, vehu amro kaasher vegomer ken asu.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichrono livracha (zevachim sav.) ki yesh perate hammitzvot sheenam leikkuv ella lemitzva, umanu chachamim devarim hameakkevim ze et ze, vehodia hakkatuv bechefel hammaase lomar sheasu kol asher tzivva, afillu devarim sheenam ella lemitzva min hammuvchar:

Vayvarech otam moshe. taam shehutzrach lomar moshe velo samach al zichrono besamuch, lomar lo tihye beracha zo kalla beenecha, ki moshe ish haelohim bercham, vedavar gadol hodia hakkatuv bedavar ze. uletaam ze hu shehodia hakkatuv veamar vayvarech otam, vezulat heyot moshe en hattora maggedet im yevarech adam lachavero.

Beyom hachodesh vegomer. hakama zo hayta achar shivat yeme milluim ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 93), vechen mochichim hakketuvim ki shivat yeme hammilluim lo naasa bahem ella millue yede aharon, velaze tzivva Adonai maase shivat yeme milluim kodem mitzvat hakamat hammishkan vehaarachato, vegam befarashat tzav keshemmashach aharon uvanav yom rishon shel milluim sham hizkir meshichat hammishkan vechelav, velo hizkir sham hakamat hammishkan vesidro. ha lamadta ki hammilluim hayu kodem hakamat hammishkan vehaarachat kelav, veyom rosh chodesh nisan hu shennitkaddesh hammishkan vesidder moshe maarechet hammishkan vehikriv bo et haamur bainyan. ha lamadta shello shimmesh moshe bammishkan beseder kol haamur befarasha zo ella beyom echad, shehu yom hashshemini shel milluim. vaafillu lehassovrim shekkol shivat yeme hammilluim haya moshe bone mishkan vesotro (yerushalmi yoma 1,5), behechreach lomar ki mishkan hu shehaya bone vesoter aval seder hachanato lo hayta ella beyom rosh chodesh nisan, kaamur bainyan "beechad lachodesh vegomer vesamta sham vegomer veheveta et hashshulchan" vegomer. hare ki mechadash hu modio hahaaracha umekom kol davar veseder hannachato, veim ze lo shivat yamim vehu maarich, ma makom lehodia mechadash? ella vadday ze hayyom techillat seder maase hammishkan vetikkuno, vehikriv moshe bo bayyom kol haamur bainyan bemitzvat Adonai elav, kaamur lefanenu.

rashi: Vayyaviu et hammishkan vegomer. shello hayu yecholin lahakimo; ulefi shello asa moshe shum melacha vammishkan, hinniach lo hakkabba hakamato, shello haya yachol lahakimo shum adam mechamat koved hakkerashim, sheen koach baadam lezakfan, umoshe heemido; amar moshe lifne hakkabba ech efshar hakamato ay adam? amar lo asok atta beyadcha, venire kimkimo vehu nizkaf vekam meelav, vezehu shenne hukam hammishkan (Shemot 40) – hukam meelav; midrash Rabbi tanchuma:
ohc: Vayyaviu et hammishkan. perush, hizminuhu lefanav.

rashi: Uvetzalel ben uri vegomer asa et kol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe. asher tzivva moshe en ketiv kan, ella kol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe, afillu devarim shello amar lo rabbo, hiskima dato lema shenneemar lemoshe besinay, ki moshe tzivva livtzalel laasot techilla kelim veachar kach mishkan, amar lo betzalel minhag olam laasot techilla bayit veachar kach mesim kelim betocho. amar lo kach shamati mippi 112. amar lo moshe betzel el hayita, ki bevadday kach tzivva li 112, vechen asa hammishkan techilla veachar kach asa hakkelim:

Umin hattechelet vehaargaman vegomer. shesh lo neemar kan, umikkan ani omer sheen bigde serad hallalu bigde chehunna, shebbevigde chehunna haya shesh, ella hem begadim shemmechassim bahem kele hakkodesh bishat silluk massaot, shello haya vahem shesh:
ohc: Kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe. taam amro ken bechol perat uferat, al pi ma shekkatavnu befarashat tetzavve (Shemot 27:20) ki chalak Adonai lemoshe chelek bechol melachot vaavodot hannaasot bammishkan, ki chelko bammaase hu hammitzva asher yetzavve Adonai haddavar al yado, laze mazkiro bechol perat uferat shehagam sheeno ose hare hu metzavve laasot.
Od yirtze, shehayu omrim bishat hammelacha: "hare anu osim davar ze kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe".

Od nire lefi ma shekkadam lanu, ki en lecha mitzva sheen bah perate hahaskala, velo nichtav battora ella miut, kemaamar rabbi yochanan behannizzakin (gittin 60,2), umillevad ze yesh bechol maase mimmaase hammishkan musekol, vehu penimiyyut haddevarim. veelle yeasu bechavvanat hallev uvesichliyyut hannelam, veyeasu davar bemino kayyadua leyode daat vehabbinyan, vehu ma sheramza hattora bechol perat uferat kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe, perush, beal pe veeno meforash battora letzad yekar haddavar. veaskilcha ki hammichtav hu mibbechinat hammufeal, vehammusekol meshullal mehitkabbel miktzato bivchinat hahefel, umiktzato gam mibbechinat hannidbar ki rachok hu bishte haderagot. uketzat ramaz Adonai bannifal, nire veeno nire, besod tzurat haotiyyot vetamehem vaatarot sheal rashehem hattagin umaasehem bechinat machshava yikkaru, venigla lemoshe besinay pile pelaot. vetze ulemad midderashat rabbi akiva (sanhedrin kav,1) shelosh meot halachot beelyono shel lamed, hemma rau maase Adonai. vehodia hakkatuv bechol perate hammishkan ki asauhu kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe kechol niflaot asher yechavven alehem.

rashi: Vayrakkeu. kemo leroka haaretz (Tehillim 136), ketargumo uredidu, tassin hayu meraddedin min hazzahav, ashetanedarea belaaz, tassin dakkot. kan hu melammedcha heach hayu tovin et hazzahav im hachutin, meraddedim tassin dakkin, vekotztzin mehen petilim leorech hattas – laasot otan petilim taarovet im kol min vamin bachoshen veefod shenne bahen zahav, chut echad shel zahav im 6 chutin shel techelet, vechen im kol min vamin, shekkol hamminim chutan kaful 6, vehazzahav chut shevii im kol echad veechad:
Hafachpach derech ish vazar. ish vehu zar, sar min hammitzva, darko hafachpach:
targum: Dehappech archeh degavra hu nuchera vedidche teritzan ovadohi:

rashi: Kikkar. shishshim mane, umane shel kodesh kaful haya, hare hakkikkar 120 mane, vehammane 25 selaim, hare kikkar shel kodesh sheloshet alafim shekalim, lefichach mana bifrotrot kol hashshekalim sheppechutin beminyanam mig alafim, sheen maggiin lechikkar:
ohc: Kol hazzahav heasuy vegomer. tzarich ladaat gezerat hakkatuv ayye mekomah, veim amro "tesha veesrim kikkar" im ken lamma chazar lomar vayhi zehav vegomer, veulay ki gezerat hakkatuv hu bechol melechet hakkodesh vechavvanat hakkatuv hi lomar shekkol hazzahav heasuy lammelacha lo nechsar velo nifsha velo nignav mimmennu davar, ella hakkol nichnas bechol melechet hakkodesh, uvaze hotzi haummanim haosim bammelacha mehachashad.

Od yirtze lehodia nissim shennaasu bizhav hammishkan, ki davar yadua hu ki baasot haadam keli mizzahav o mishshear hammattachot, al kol panim yitmaet mishshiur mishkal hazzahav shennaasa mimmennu hakkeli, velo yaamod hakkeli bammishkal harishon letzad hahitchallekut ufeullot hammelachotav, uma gam kesheyyihye bammelacha ribbuy hitchallekut vachalakim dakkim peshita sheyyitmaet beemtzaut ken. veod, behachin haadam maase hammelacha, kemo shettomar sheti vaerev leerog beged petile zahav laasot mehem hammelacha, min hannimna sheyyedakdek bammuchan lo pachot velo yoter. vechan hodia hakkatuv shennaasa nes shekkol hazzahav heasuy lammelacha haya bechol melechet hakkodesh. meamro kol hodiacha shello nitmaet meemtzaut hammelacha kannizkar, umeamro heasuy rasham gam ken shekkol hammuchan lammelacha lo notar mimmennu davar levattala vehakkol nichnas bechol melechet hakkodesh. vedikdek lomar bechol velo amar "bimlechet hakkodesh", nitkavven lomar gam ken shehispik heasuy lakkol. veze hu ikkar hannes, shezzulat ze en nes bema shello hotir, ki efshar sheshshier shiur shevvadday lo yotir, velo hukkar hannes ella beemtzaut shello hotir velo hechsir.

rashi: Latet al hammitznefet milmala. veay happetilim haya moshivo al hammitznefet kemin keter; veie lomar hatztzitz al hammitznefet, shehare vishchitat kadashim shaninu searo haya nire ben tzitz lammitznefet sheshsham meniach tefillin, vehatztzitz haya natun al hammetzach, hare hammitznefet lemala vehatztzitz lematta, umahu al hammitznefet milmala? veod hiksheti vah – kan hu omer vayyittenu alav petil techelet, uveinyan hatztzavvaa hu omer vesamta oto al petil techelet? veomer ani, petil techelet ze chutin hen, lekashro bahen bammitznefet – lefi shehatztzitz eno ella meozen leozen uvamme yiksherennu vemitzcho? – vehayu kevuin bo chute techelet lishne rashav uveemtzaito, shebbahen koshro vetolehu vammitznefet keshehu verosho, ushene chutin hayu bechol katze vekatze, echad mimmaal veechad mittachat letzad mitzcho, vechen beemtzao, shekkach hu noach likshor, veen derech keshira befachot mishshene chutin, lechach neemar al petil techelet, vealav petil techelet, vekosher rashehem hashshenayim kullan yachad meachorav lemul arpo, umoshivo al hammitznefet; veal titma shello neemar petile techelet hoil umerubbin hen, shehare matzinu vechoshen veefod vayyirkesu et hachoshen … biftil techelet, veal karchacha pachot mishshenayim lo hayu shehare vishne ketzot hachoshen hayu 2 tabbeot hachoshen, uvishte chitfot haefod hayu 2 tabbeot haefod, shekkenegdan, ulefi derech keshira 4 chutin hayu umikkol makom pachot mishshenayim ie:

ohc: Kechol asher tzivva Adonai. vechazar lomar paam sheniyya davar ze, vegam besamuch paam shelishit, ulay ki letzad shechatu baegel bemachshava uvedibbur uvemaase, uchemo shepperashti sham, uvivchinat kol achat kafru bechol hattora kullah, asher al ken battikkun hayu shelashtam yachad: hannedava hu hammaase, hammachshava hi bechinat hachachma shebbammelacha, haddibbur hu shehayu omrim bishat maase leshem mitzvat Adonai, kemo shepperashti bakkodem, ucheneged shelashtam amar hakkatuv sheasu kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe ki tikkenu shalosh haderagot hara.

Al shule vegomer. mikkan ani medayyek shehaemet hu kehassovrim shehappaamonim hem beshura im harimmonim velo vetocham mammash, shehare hikdim hakkatuv netinat harimmonim al shule hammeil, veachar kach amar maase happaamonim bifne atzman "vayyittenu otam toch harimmonim". umeatta im happaamon toch harimmon mammash, lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lomar "al shule" achar shekkevar kadam veamar sheharimmonim hem al shule hammeil? ze baze taluy. vetameah ani al ramban sheppana midderech ze, uma sheyyishshev shello natan harimmon bammeil ad shennatan betocho happaamon – hakkatuv yaggid hefech ze. umimma sheamar ki laze kafal lomar "betoch harimmonim" paamayim, kashe lamma hikdim hakkatuv letzauot sheyyitten harimmonim al shule hammeil kodem sheyyaase happaamonim veyitztarech lachazor lomar paamayim "betoch harimmonim" lerabbot sheyyittenem kodem. ufashut hu sheharav lo dak yafe keminhag zechut iyyuno hakkadosh.

rashi: Elle fekude. befarasha zo nimnu chol mishkele nidvat hammishkan, lakkesef velazzahav velannechoshet, venimnu chol kelav lechol avodato:
Hammishkan mishkan. shene feamim, remez lammikdash shennitmashken bishne churbanin al avonotehen shel yisrael (tanchuma):
Mishkan haedut. edut leyisrael shevvitter lahem hakkabba al maase haegel, shehare hishra shechinato benehem:
Avodat haleviyyim. pekude hammishkan vechelav hi avoda hammesura lalviyim bammidbar – laset ulehorid ulehakim, ish ish lemassao hammufkad alav, kemo sheamur befa naso:
Beyad itamar. hu haya pakid alehem limsor lechol bet av avoda shealav:
ohc: Elle fekude vegomer. amro elle lifsol kol minyanim shebbaolam, ki chol ma sheyyimne adam mikkinyanim hammedummim en minyano minyan, ushemo more alav ma atta mone, aval minyan ze omed leolam, vehattaam leheyot minyan hammishkan hammufla asher shachan sham elohe olam Adonai.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 42.): en beracha shora lo bedavar hassafur velo bedavar hammanuy, vechan amar elle fekude, perush, leelle yesh minyan veen hakepada, ki minyan ze adrabba minyano tavi habberacha, ki chol perat sheyyirbe bammispar tagdil hazzechut utesovev habberacha lammarbe, vehattaam lihyoto shel hammishkan.

Od yirmoz beamro elle al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 21,5) im asita chavilot vechulei ase kenegdan chavilot shel mitzvot, ki tzarich haadam letakken hachet bedugema. vehinne yisrael chatu veamru (Shemot 32,4) "elle elohecha", laze baa elle zot bivchinat hazzechut lechapparat avon ze. vetimtza ki amru (Shemot Rabba) haedut sheedut hu lahem shennitkapper avon haegel. ucheshettedakdek timtza ki kol perate avon haegel ba kenegdan bammishkan: hem hitauu taava (Shemot 32,1) elohim asher yelchu lifnehem, hinne hinnam hechinu makom laAdonai elohim emet lihyot lifnehem. hem banu mizbeach veheelu olot (sham 6), hinne hinnam hechinu mizbeach lehaalot olot ushelamim laAdonai. hem natnu zehavam, hinne hinnam natnu zehavam vechaspam vechol kele chemdatam laAdonai. hem parku nizmehem, hinne hinnam heviu haanashim al hannashim lo nezem levad ella kol adayam mealehem vechol kele chemda, uchemo shepperashnu befarashat vayyakhel (Shemot la,22). hem asu memunnim alav laasoto, hinne hinnam pakdu betzalel laasot vechulei. amru "elle elohecha", hinne elle fekude lechappara.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: leheyot shemmoshe asa hammispar leyisrael hammuva bet Adonai, laze baa hattora vehitzdikattu veamra elle fekude vegomer, perush al derech amro (Vayikra 23:2) "elle hem moaday", ma hu hammispar she matzdik, "asher pukkad al pi moshe", dikdek lomar al pi moshe velo amar "asher pakad moshe", hattaam ki lo haya hazzulat immo lehitztaddek ella mippiv anu chayyin, shekken ketiv (Shemot 36:3) "vayyikchu millifne moshe" shehu levaddo lakach hakkol.

Vetamo shel moshe shehevi atzmo lide chashad, ulay shello ala bedato chashad ze lehishshamer mimmennu, ki ech yachshedu oto vaAdonai medabber immo bechol et, im chas veshalom yimmatze bo avel yimasennu eloah hayyodea nistarot, veen tzarich lomar shello yedabber itto od elohim. o dikdek maamar Adonai sheamar lo (Shemot 25:2): "dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu li" vegomer kemo shepperashnuha bimkomah, ki tzivva lo lihyot hu gizbar levaddo, visharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam af al pi shepposhim yikkashlu vam.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: elle fekude hammishkan – umi yatzdik shekken hu velo yoter? laze amar "mishkan haedut", perush, hammishkan hu yaid al haddavar, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 132) befasuk "vayyakem moshe et hammishkan" shello haya echad miyyisrael yachol lehaamido, veze leshonam: kamma chachamim hayu sham velo hayu yecholin lehakim et hammishkan vechulei, velo hayu yodim leyashshev oto, kol echad natal melachto vehalach etzel moshe vechulei, vesharta ruach hakkodesh al moshe vehekim et hammishkan, ad kan. ze hu eduto heyoto neki kappayim sheen chamas bechappav, sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ose nes leose avel, uvifrat bammakom atzmo shennaasa bo heavel chas veshalom.

Veim tomar: uma edut hu zo? yesh litlot ki letzad ki moshe haya gibbor chayil, gevurato amda lo sheheemido ma shello haya koach kemo chen bezulato, laze gamar omer avodat haleviyyim beyad itamar vegomer, perush, halo timtza sheavodat haleviyyim shehi beyad itamar hi karshe hammishkan uverichav veammudav vaadanav, vehem hammoridim oto benasam umekimin oto bachanotam, dichtiv befarashat bammidbar (Bamidbar 1:51): "uvachanot hammishkan yakimu oto haleviyyim", hare shehaleviyyim hayu mefarkin umekimin oto, im ken lo meniat hakkoach hi hassibba; uchefi ze hirvachnu kavvanat amro avodat haleviyyim vegomer beyad itamar sheen yadua ma ba lelammed uma shayyachut lemaamar ze kan, velamma lo amar ella itamar velo elazar haggadol, uledarkenu yavo al nachon.

Vaadayin yesh litlot letzad hachachma ki moshe chacham vecharif haya veyada lahakimo, uleolam lo naasu maase nissim. laze amar uvetzalel ben uri vegomer asa et kol asher tzivva Adonai, veamru zichronam livracha sheafillu devarim shello amar lo moshe hiskima dato, veitto oholiav vegomer charash vegomer, veaf al pi chen lo amda lo chachmato, ucheamram bammidrash (Shemot Rabba 132) sheggam ummanut haummanim lo hoila. uchefi ze hirvachnu kavvanat hakkatuv behodaat maase betzalel achar shekkevar yadanu ze paamayim veshalosh befarashat vayyakhel, ella ba lechazzek edut nes hammishkan lomar ha lamadta sheen ze ella nes, vezo hi edut hammishkan al pekudav. ulederech ze, amro asher pukkad al pi moshe, lomar sheal ze baa haedut lehasir hachashad mimmennu.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba nusach acher) shehammishkan haya kappara al maase haegel. od amru bechullin (chullin 5.) ki shekula avoda zara kechol hattora kullah, vehu amro "elle fekude", perush, al derech shettirgem uneklos (Vayikra 27:34) "elle hammitzvot" – "illen pikkodaya", hammitzvot shetteluyim bammishkan. mishkan haedut asher pukkad vegomer, perush, kol hammitzvot shebbattora shennitztavva moshe kullam yeshnam bemitzvot hammishkan, uvaze yechapper hammishkan al haegel sheshshakul keneged kol hattora. veulay shennitkavven lirmoz hainyan becheshbon pekude hammishkan sheole 615 vehem 613 mitzvot ushene halluchot, umeatta elle tishkachna ki nitkan bifkude hammishkan.

Veamro avodat haleviyyim ba lishmor et haddavar, leval tomar kevan shennitkapper avon haegel asher hu yesovev hasarat avoda mehabbechorot kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 12), im ken tachzor haatara leyashnah veyaavdu habbechorot avodat hammishkan. laze amar samuch laddavar avodat haleviyyim perush, avoda zo enah ella lalviyyim, kan kalal kol shevet levi, ben hakkohanim ben haleviyyim, ki gam hakkohanim yikkaru leviyyim dichtiv (Devarim 27:9) "vehakkohanim haleviyyim".

Veamro beyad itamar vegomer, perush, lo mibbaya avodot hammeullot shel hakkohanim, velo mibbaya avodot haleviyyim hammeullot shel bene kehat uvene gershon, ella afillu avoda hakkalla shel haleviyyim beyad itamar shehem hakkerashim vehaadanim, haddavar bimkomo omed, umizze atta lamed ki lo nimchak avon haegel mechak sheen rishshumo nikkar, vehaed hanneeman (Shemot 32:34) "uveyom pakdi" vegomer:

Od yirmoz beamro fekude hammishkan leshon minnuy, al derech amro (Bamidbar 4:16) "ufekuddat elazar" shehu leshon minnuy al haddavar, vehodia hakkatuv kol minnuye hammishkan, mehem memunnim al hammishkan atzmo lehitkayyem o lehitbattel chas veshalom, umehem al avodato, umehem al ovdav, umehem al melachto. vehitchil beminnuy kiyyum hammishkan veamar mishkan haedut, perush, pekuddat hammishkan hu haedut shehi hattora, ki chol zeman sheyyisrael oskim battora umekayyemin mitzvoteha yitkayyem hammishkan, vezulat ze en mishkan. vehu amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 32) befasuk (tehillim 78:60) "ohel shikken baadam", vechi baadam shikken oholo? ella beemtzaut adam, im yachinu libbam lilmod tora ulekayyem mitzvoteha. velav davka edut hakketuva balluchot uvassefer ketuva, ella asher pukkad al pi moshe, perush, tora shebbeal pe shennimsera lemoshe lappe velo lechatvah. 2, yechavven al pekuddat moshe sheppakid hu bedavar ze letzauot mishpatav vedinav shel mishkan. minnuy 3 hem haovdim bammishkan "avodat haleviyyim", perush, hem memunnim al avodat hammishkan. minnuy 4 hem aharon uvanav, ushelashtam remazam hakkatuv itamar veaharon, hare neemru beferush, veelazar remazo beamro ben aharon, ki ani yodea ki itamar beno shel aharon hu, ella lirmoz al elazar. veulay shello hizkira hattora aharon kol ikkar beminnuy hammishkan ella banav, veamro ben aharon hakkohen yechavven el elazar, velo hizkir aharon letzad sheadayin chaser tikkun maase haegel sheasa, ki achare chen metu shene banav vehevi kapparato beyom shemini lammilluim, asher al ken lo hizkir pekuddato ella hizkir shemo im beno. minnuy Adonai hu haose melechet hammishkan, vehu sheamar uvetzalel vegomer asa vegomer veitto oholiav vegomer. nimtzeta omer shehammemunnim bifrat ze shel hammishkan hem Adonai: 1, hattora hi moshelet al kiyyumo im yitkayyem im lav. 2, moshe memunne al mitzvato beeze ofen yease veyitnaheg. 3, haleviyyim laavod lifrok veliton vechulei. 4, hakkohanim laavod haavodot ulehitmannot al haleviyyim baavodatam. Adonai, uvetzalel veoholiav al hammelacha, veal elle amar elle fekude hammishkan.

rashi: Mekallel aviv veimmo yidach nero beeshun choshech. behaneshif uvehashchir hachoshech, kelomar: bevo haraa:
targum: Delayet laavuy uleimeh nidach sherageh ech etuna dachashocha:

rashi: Beka. hu shem mishkal shel machatzit hashshekel:

Leshesh meot elef vegomer. kach hayu yisrael, vechach ala minyanam achar shehukam hammishkan besefer vaydabber, veaf atta benidvat hammishkan kach hayu, uminyan chatzae hashshekalim shel shesh meot elef ole meat kikkar, kol echad shel sheloshet alafim shekalim, ketzad? shesh meot elef chatzain hare hen shelosh meot elef shelemim, hare meat kikkar, vehashsheloshet alafim vaAdonai meot vachamishshim chatzaim olim elef vez meot ve shekalim:
Vearachta et erko. shetayim maarachot shel lechem happanim:
Al yerech hammishkan tzafona. bachetzi hatztzefoni shel rochav habbayit:
Yerech. ketargumo, tzidda, kayyarech hazze shehu betziddo shel adam:

Velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed. vechatuv echad omer uvevo moshe el ohel moed (Bamidbar 7)? ba hakkatuv hashshelishi vehichria benehem – ki shachan alav heanan, emor meatta kol zeman shehaya alav heanan lo haya yachol lavo, nistallek heanan nichnas umedabber immo (sifra):
ohc: Velo yachol moshe vegomer. vahagam sheamar hakkatuv befarashat mishpatim (Shemot 24:18) "vayyavo moshe betoch heanan", sham haya achar shekkara elav Adonai natan bo koach. o yomar al ze hadderech velo yachol moshe vegomer, vehattaam ki shachan alav heanan veen metziut ze kimtziut haamur befarashat mishpatim, ki chan kevod Adonai male et hammishkan, ma sheen ken heanan shebba bo behar sinay, sham neemar (Shemot 24:17): "umare kevod Adonai keesh ochelet berosh hahar", vesamuch leh: "vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar", perush – makom sheen sham shochen kevod Adonai, ma sheen ken bema shellefanenu shehaya kevod Adonai male hammishkan, velo yachol likkanes bimkom melo kevodo yitbarach.
Chassalat parashat pikkude salik sefer Shemot

Betoch harimmonim. taam shekkafal lomar ken, lomar sheyyihyu mechuvvanim happaamonim keneged harimmonim, shello yihye happaamon mashuch letzad matta o letzad mala, ella gufo shel paamon lifne harimmon veomed beshura, lo lemala velo lematta. vedavar ze eno mitchayyev meamro paam rishona "happaamonim betoch harimmonim", ki ze ba lishlol shello yihyu harimmonim betoch happaamonim. al ze haofen tatchil hashshura befaamon ulefanav rimmon, kefi ze yihyu harimmonim betoch happaamonim, ki hammeil lo haya mechubbar millematta saviv lomar shettamid yihyu ellu toch ellu kol sheyyihyu shavim bemispar, ella mechullak haya lishnayim, velaze timtza shello asa babberayta mispar harimmonim kappaamonim ki hem yoter mehem (zevachim pach,2).

rashi: Nachala mevohelet barishona. shennivhal lemaher velittol techilla, kegon bene gad uvene reuven shemmiharu littol chelkam beever hayyarden vedibberu bevehala, shenneemar "gidrot tzon nivne lemiknenu po vearim letappenu" (Bamidbar 32:16) – asu et haikkar tafel, shehikdimu tzonam letappam (tanchuma, mattot 7):

Veacharitah lo tevorach. sheggalu kamma shanim kodem shear hashshevatim, kemo shemmeforash beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 22) uvemidrash rabbi tanchuma (tanchuma, mase 10); "bishnat shetayim leachaz vayyaar Adonai et ruach melech ashshur vegomer" (divrei hayamim 1 5:26), ushear shevatim galu bishnat shesh lechizkiyyahu hi hatteshiit lehoshea ben ela (Melachim 2 17:1-6):
targum: Yeruteta dimsarhava vekadmeta uvesofa la titberech:

rashi: Verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon. yom shemini lammilluim hushvu chullam lichhunna, vetargumo umekaddeshin minne, bo vayyom kiddesh moshe immahem:
Uvet chaver. shennichnas levet chavero ledabber im ishto. umidrash aggada (avot derabbi natan lod,6; sanhedrin 103:): nibba shessof hashshechina lehistallek meal yisrael shehem keeshet midyanim:
Uvet chaver. bayit shemmechabberim bo reim lehakkadosh baruch hu, kegon tzelem sheheemid menashshe behechal Adonai (Melachim 2 21:7):
targum: Tav lemetav al karna deigra min itteta tagranita uveta tarka:

rashi: Uvekorvatam. kemo uvekarvam – kesheyyikrevu:
Mokesh adam yala kodesh. kesheadam nichshal venokesh baaverot, mekalkel et kedushshato; kemo "veshatu velau" (Ovadya 1:16):
Veachar nedarim levakker. tzarich adam lachazor achar karbanot, lindor ulehavi ulevakkesh al nafsho:
targum: Pacha hu legavra dindar lekudesha uvater hachi chadya leh nafsheh:

rashi: Mattan basseter. tzedaka:
Veshochad bachek. af zo tzedaka. yichpe af, yichpe chema azza:
targum: Muhava vetisha medaacha rugeza veshuchada uva chemta ashinta:

rashi: Vayyaal alav vegomer. af bayyom hashshemini lammilluim, shehu yom hakamat hammishkan, shimmesh moshe vehikriv karbenot tzibbur, chutz meotan shennitztauu vo vayyom, shenneemar kerav el hammizbeach vegomer (Vayikra 9):
Et haola. olat hattamid:
Veet hammincha. minchat nesachim shel tamid, kemo shenneemar veissaron solet balul beshemen vegomer (Shemot 29):

targum: Dimsakkar udneh dela nishma letzivchateh demiskena af nikra lelaha vela nitane:
Vela yachilu kahanaya lemekam leshamasha min kodam anana are itmele yekara dayya yat bet makdesha dayay:

rashi: Shene turim rimmonim. mea rimmonim betur, charuzim besharsherot.
targum: Veyat rimonaya arba mea letarten serigata teren sidrin derimonin lisrigta chada lechasaa yat tarten agane kerontevan deal appe amudaya:
Chesda vekusheta yinteru lemalka umetaken kureseh bechisda:

rashi: Yetzakam. hitticham vehitztzikam ketavnitam.
Bemaave haadama. targum: beove gargishta.
targum: Bemeshre yardena attechinun malka beove gargashta ben sukkot uven tzartan:

rashi: El mekom haaron. mikkir el kir, kemo sheamar lemala bainyan.
targum: Are cheruvaya perisan gadfehon al atar arona umatlin keruvaya al arona veal arichohi milela:

rashi: Az amar shelomo. kesheraa heanan, amar: atta roe ani shehashechina shora babbayit shebbaniti, shehare kach hivtiach lavo velishkon bo mittoch anan vaarafel, vehechan amar: ki beanan erae al hakkapporet, kach shenuya bassifri.
targum: Bechen amar shelomo Adonai itree leashraa shechinteh birushelem:

rashi: Vayyaas chirom vego'. veamar rabbi, hakkiyyorot hen hen sirot, kema deatt amar: kechiyyor esh beetzim; vechen: vehikka vakkiyyor.
Hakkiyyorot. shel nechashet, ledashen et hammizbeach.
Hayyaim. magrefot shel nechashet, shekkorin vvydvl (yae, magrefa) beashkenaz, lachatot bahen deshen betoch hassirot.
targum: Vaavad chiram yat kioraya veyat magrofyata veyat mizrekaya veshetze chiram lemebad yat kol avidta daavad lemalka shelomo bevet makdesha dayay:

rashi: Betzet hakkohanim min hakkodesh. hakkohanim shennaseu haaron baddevir, kesheyyatzeu shorta shechina bahechal.
targum: Vahava bemippak kahanaya min kudesha vaanan amitta itmele yat bet makdesha dayay:
Veaschar malka yat appohi uverich yat kol kehala deyisrael vechol kehala deyisrael kaim:
Amudaya teren vaagane kerontevan di al resh amudaya tarten userigata tarten lechasaa yat tarten agane kerontevan deal resh amudaya:

rashi: Vayyannach shelomo. millishkol et mishkal hakkelim haelle merov meod vechadal lispor mishkalam.
targum: Veatzna shelomo yat kol manaya misge lachda lachda let sof lemitkal nechasha:
Umalka shelomo vechol kenishta deyisrael deizdamnu alohi kaymin imeh kodam arona minachsin an vetorin dela yitchashvun vela yitmenun misge:
Veyat dudaya veyat magrofyata veyat mizrekaya veyat kol manaya hailen keovad mane mashkena daavad moshe ken avad chiram lemalka shelomo bet makdesha dayya nechash tav:
Veyat yama chad veyat tore tere asar techot yama:
Min kodam Adonai hilchateh degavra uvar nasha la mitbayen archateh:

rashi: Vayyerau rashe habbaddim. bapparochet shekkeneged happetach baamma teraksin, yachol yihyu mekorin bah veyotzein, talmud lomar velo yerau hachutza, ha ketzad, dochakin uvoletin keen shene dadde isha, keinyan shenneemar: ben shaday yalin.
targum: Vaarichun arichaya umitchazan reshe arichaya min kudesha al appe vet kappore vela mitchazan levara vahavo taman ad yoma haden:
Let baarona lechod teren luche avnaya deatzna taman moshe bechorev di ilavehon ketivin asra pitgame keyama digzar Adonai im bene yisrael bemippakhon meara demitzrayim:
Merachakin inun kodam elaha matkela umatkela umishchata deramyuta la shappir kodamoy:
Nafsheh derashia rayga bishta vela mitrachem beaynoy chavreh:
Veyat besisaya asar veyat kiora asra al besisaya:

rashi: Veet ohel moed. sheasa mashe, ugenazo shelomo mishennivna bayit rishon, kemo sheshaninu betosefta desota (13 1).
Asher baohel. asher nata david laaron.
targum: Veasiku yat arona dayya veyat mashkan zimna veyat kol mane kudesha di vemashkena veasiku yathon kahanaya velevae:

rashi: Beyerach haetanim. tirgem yonatan: beyarcha deattikayya dekaran leh yarcha kadmaa bechagga uchean hu yarcha sheviaa, mishennittena tora uchetiv benisan shehu rosh chodashim, nikra tishre shevii.
targum: Veitkenishu levat malka shelomo kol enash yisrael beyarcha deattikaya dekaran leh yarcha kadmaa bechaga uchean hu yarcha sheviaa:
Hech teyafe demaya libbeh demalka beaydoy delaha velaatar detzave nirchan leh:

rashi: Leshivtecha olamim. shemmishennivchara, lo huttaru habbamot, velo shorta shechina bemakom acher.
targum: Mivna veneti bet makdesha kodamach atar metakan levet shechintach almin:

rashi: Chamesh miyyamin vechamesh missemol. i efshar lomar chamesh mimin happetach vechamesh missemol happetach, im ken matzinu menora batztzafon, vehattora omra: al yerech hammishkan temana, ella shel mashe baemtza, chamesh miminah, vechamesh missemolah.
Vehapperach. shel menora.
Vehannerot. bazichin shennotenin bahen hashemen vehappetila.
Vehammelkachayim. shemmerimim bahen et happetila mittoch hashemen.
targum: Veyat menarta chamesh mimina vachamesh mismala kodam bet kafore dahava tava veshoshanta uvotzinaya vetzivtaya dahava:

rashi: Kanfe hakkeruvim. otan sheasa shelomo haomedim al raglehem bakkarka, veen ellu keruvim shel kapporet sheal haaron.
targum: Veailu chahanaya yat aron keyama dayya leatreh levet kappore di metaken leh bego veta lekodesh kudeshaya litchot kanfe cheruvaya:
Man deaved tzidketa vedina mitree beh elaha min divcha:

rashi: Nesie haavot livne yisrael. shel bene yisrael.
Meir david. shennetano sham david keshehevio mibbet oved edom.
targum: Bechen kenash shelomo yat save yisrael veyat kol reshe shivtaya ravreve avhata divne yisrael levat malka shelomo lirushelem leasaka yat aron keyama dayya mikarta dedavid hi tzion:
La temar ashalem bishta sacha lelahach veyifrekinach:
Vaavad shelomo yat kol manaya di bevet makdesha dayya yat madbecha dedahava veyat patora di alohi lecham appaya dahava:

rashi: Et kodshe david aviv. ma shennishar mikkesef vezahav shehikdish aviv. umidrash aggada: shello ratza shelomo latet meoto hekdesh levinyan habbayit. veshamati mechachme yisrael shehayu omerin: lefi shehaya yodea shessofo lecharev, shello yihyu haovede kochavim omerim, kasha yiratam, shellakechu nikmatam min habbayit, shennivna min gezelot vachavalot sheggazal mehem david. veyesh omerim: kach amar shelomo, raav haya bime aviv shalash shanim, shana achar shana, vehaya lo levazbez hahekdeshot hallalu, lehachayot bahen aniyye yisrael.
targum: Ushelimat kol ividta daavad shelomo malka bet makdesha dayya veayte shelomo yat kudeshe david avuhi yat kaspa veyat dahava veyat manaya yehav beotzraya bet makdesha dayay:
Vaato kol save yisrael unetalu chahanaya yat arona:

rashi: Vehassippot. keli shel mine zemer hu, vechen mezammerot.
Vehammizrakot. lekabbel dam.
Vehakkappot. levaziche levona.
Vehammachtot. lachatot bahen terumat haddeshen vegechalim leholich mimmizbeach hachitzon lammizbeach happenimi lehaktir ketoret.
Vehappotot. maftechot, shamati. shemmefattechin bahem et hammanul.
Ledaltot habbayit. shehu kodesh kadashim.
Ledalte habbayit. shehu lahechal, kol pitchotehen hayu zahav.
targum: Vekolaya umezamraya umizrekaya uvazichaya umachteyata dahava tava umugelsaya ledashe vet gavaa lekodesh kudeshaya ledashe veta lehechla dahava:

bart: Vehachovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim chayyav. veaf al gav divchol hattora kullah haover avera shechayyav aleha malkot vetashlumin loke veeno meshallem, hacha meshallem veeno loke, divferush ribbeta tora chovel bachavero letashlumin velo lemalkot, middichtiv (Devarim 19) yad beyad, dehaynu mamon, mikkedi ketiv (Vayikra 24) kaasher asa chen yease lo, yad beyad lamma li, ella lehavi chovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim, shemmeshallem veeno loke:
Rabbi yehuda omer en laavadim boshet. dichtiv (Devarim 25) ki yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv, bemi sheyyesh lo achava, yatza eved sheen lo achava. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hamechammetz vehametabbel vechulei. hachi kaamar, kol hamechammetz vehametabbel baarla uvechile hakkerem asur:

Vehamedammea batteruma. hamechammetz et haissa betappuchim o veshimre yayin shel arla veshel kile hakkerem, vehametabbel et hakkedera bitvalin shel kile hakkerem o shel arla, asur, veen olin beechad umatayim. vechen batteruma, kevan shehechemitza issa shel chullin bisor shel teruma venitbela kedera shel chullin bitvalin shel teruma, naase hakkol medumma, veasur lezarim, veeno ole beechad umea:

Bet shammay omrim af metamme. seor tame shehechemitz issa tehora o tevalin temein shettibbelu kedera tehora, af al pi sheen basseor o vattevalin kabbetza shehu shiur tumat ochalin, nitmet haissa venitmet hakkedera:
Uvet hillel omrim ad sheyyehe bo kabbetza. deen ochel metamme pachot mikkabbetza, lo shena seor utevalin velo shena shear ochalin:
Haasla. bet moshav shel barzel mechusse or, veyoshvim alav bevet hakkisse:
Persha. haor min habbarzel:
Haor tame midras. deor bifne atzmo chazi lishiva, vehabbarzel belo or lo chazi lishiva, vachazi lishar tashmishim:
Teraskal. sal katan asuy mearava kelufa, veochlim alav lechem:
Vehatteraskal tahor mikkelum. demippene katno lo chazi lishiva. velo lishar tashmishin, sheen lo defanot:
Safsalim shebbammerchatz. shel shayish hen:

Sheshshete raglav shel etz tame. im yashav hazzav alav temein haraglayim: shel etz. mishshum moshav. aval hassafsal atzmo tahor, dichle avanim en lahem tuma chelal lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:
Veachat shel even tahor. dahave cheillu hassafsal kullo meeven:
Sheshshiggeman. sheppisselan vetiknan birhitni:
Sheyyehu hammayim holchim tachtehen. velav lishiva avide, aval bene adam yoshvim sham kede shello yittannefu mimme hammerchatzaot hayyotzim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kankelin. keli shemmesimin tachtav esh vegafrit kede leashshen habbegadim shealav:
Sheyyesh bah bet kabbalat kesut. sheyyesh lah bet kibbul lekabbel habbegadim shealeha:
Kechavveret. mefulleshet mishshene tzedadim:

Uvo verecha. minhag ovde adama shechofrim gumma velokchim yichur echad min hailan vetomnin oto beoto gumma veyotze shoresh hayyichur mitztzad acher venaase sham ilan, verosh hayyichur nishar mechubbar bailan, veen din arla noheg bo beodo mechubbar lailan veyonek mimmennu, af al pi shehu yonek gam min hakkarka. veim neekar ilan hazzaken min hakkarka venimtza shekkol chayyuto vinikato atta min habberecha:
Chazra hazzekena lihyot kabberecha. ushenehem, hazzekena vehabberecha havo keillu nitteu atta, umonim lahem shalosh shanim mishshaa shenneekar hailan:
Hivrichah shana achar shana. leachar shehigdila berecha rishona lakach mimmennu yichur vehivricho vaaretz, vechen asa kamma feamim ze achar ze:
Mone. lechullan shene arla mishshennifseka habberecha harishona min hailan:

Sippuk gefanim. derech ovde adama shellokchim zemora arukkah miggefen zo umoshchim otah laggefen shebbetziddah umarkivin hazzemora baggefen, vezehu hannikra sippuk, ufatur min haarla. veha ditnan echad hannotea veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv chayyav baarla, hatam mayre keshechatach hazzemora min haggefen o hayyichur min hailan, veachar kach hivrichan o hirkivan:

Makom shekkochah yafe muttar. im hazzemora shehivrichuha baggefen kochah yafe veyonka min haggefen asher mimmenna lukkacha, muttar ufetura min haarla. veim kochah ra chayyevet baarla. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Vehi melea ferot. im telashan miyyad, hen muttarin mippene sheggadlu behetter. veim hinnichan bailan vegadlu leachar shennifseka veen bapperot sheggadlu kevar matayim levattel hattosefet, asur, dearla oseret ad matayim. vehu haddin beilan zaken shenneekar uvo perot, vechazar ushetalo:
Mippene shehu niddon benafsho. sheaf al pi shehu mekalkel, metakken hu etzel yitzro, sheshshachcha chamato venach ragzo bechach:
Nishba lo. al sheker, vehoda:
Yolichennu acharav afillu lemaday. deen lo kappara ad sheyyachzir lannigzal atzmo. degabbe nishba al sheker ketiv (Vayikra 5) laasher hu lo yittenennu:
Lo yitten lo livno. shel nigzal. delo have hashava ad demate leyadeh:
Lishliach bet din. takkana hu deavud rabbanan mippene takkanat hashshavim, shello nechayyevennu laze lehotzi mane behotzaat hadderech:
Veim met. hannigzal:
Chayyav beacharayuto. demikki genavah kam leh birshuteh, vahashava daavad lav hashava hi:

Veim lo yadu vo vechulei. matnitin hachi mittartza, chayyav beacharayuto ben manu ben lo manu. ematay, bizman shello yadu bo habbealim bignevato uvachazarato. aval yadu habbealim bignevato umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema, patur milleshallem. vehachi perushah, met o nignav hattale leachar shehecheziro haggannav, chayyav beacharayuto, ben shemmanu habbealim hatztzon vehi shelema ben shello manu hatztzon. ematay, bizman shello yadu habbealim bignevat hattale, shekkol tzon shehi regila latzet chutz, tzarich lizzaher bah beyoter, vezo hoil velo yadu habbealim bignevatah veshehayta lemuda latzet velo nizharu bah, chayyav haggannav leshallem, shebbigramato neevda hatztzon. aval im yadu habbealim bignevat hattale, veachar kach manu hatztzon venimtzet shelema, shehuchzar hattale hagganuv, im ken kevar yadu sheyyesh tzon achat shellemuda latzet chutz, vehaya lahem lehizzaher bah, veim lo nizharu inhu deafsud, ufatur haggannav milleshallem:
Shennitarva vintiot. shel hetter, veeno makkir hannetia shel arla:
Veshel kile hakkerem. kegon sheheevir atzitz nakuv tachat gefen achat veneesra, veeno makkirah ben shear gefanim:
Hare ze lo yilkot. dechevan sheeno makkir otah shel issur kullan asurot:

Af yitkavven veyilkot. dachazaka en adam oser karmo bintia achat, velo chayshinan dilma ate learev hannetia lechattechilla. veaf al gav divalma en mevattelin issur lechattechilla, hacha milleta delo shechicha hi velo gazur. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Natan leummanin letakken. natan lahem etzim laasot keli. uleachar shennaasa hakkeli kilkeluhu, chayyavim leshallem deme hakkeli velo deme etzim bilvad:
Natan lecharash. hasheta ashmoinan sheim natan keli asuy leumman kede letakkeno, vekilkelo, chayyav leshallem deme hakkeli. vetana sefa legilluye resha, dela tema resha mayre bichli asuy:
Shidda. agala shel etz haasuya lemerkav nashim:

Al menat liftor chayyav. im shealo chovel lannechbal, al menat liftor oti atta omer samme et eni, veheshivo hannechbal hen, af al pi chen chayyav, sheyyesh hen shehu kelav, uvilshon temiha amar lo hen, sheen derech bene adam limchol al tzaar gufan. aval haomer lachavero shabber et kaddi, ushealo hammazzik al menat liftor oti atta omer, af al pi sheheshivo nizzak lav, ze hallav hu kehen, ucheillu amar lo vechi lo amarti lecha al menat liftor, ulefichach patur, shekken derech bene adam limchol al nizke mamon:
Besisaot. veet kanno metargeminan veyat besiseh:
Veshel delufki. keli etz shemmesimim bo tzelochiyyot vaashishot voochalim umashkim, umimmennu notlim venotnim al hashshulchan. vehabbasis shellefanav eno lishiva, aval torat keli alav:
Veshel migdal. otzar shel etz. 458 belaaz:
Tahor mikkelum. delav keli hu vetzurato mochachat alav:
Levilon tame teme met. heasuy lemasach lifne happetach, tame, lefi shehashshammash mitattef beshulav lifamim umitchammem bo:
Shel tzurot. beged shehu veyad rokem uvo mine tzurot kede lirot bo laasot kemoto beveged acher:
Shenayim mechippuyav. milluchot haasuyot lemoshav:
Rabbi akiva metamme. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Venishtayyer bo vet kabbala. shehu chalul ketzat verauy lekabbel rimmonim, tahor. velo metammeinan leh mippene sheyyesh lo vet kibbul:

Mippene shebbatal haikkar. deikkaro lishiva avid velo levet kibbul, vehoil venitbattel haikkar shebbaavuro haya chashuv keli, batla hattefela, velo mittamme mittaam sheyyesh lo vet kibbul. vechen halacha. dehachi tenan leel perek hamefarek gabbe mishpelet. uveferek karim uchesatot gabbe chemet:

Notel adam kede challa vechulei. harotze lalush kamma issot shel demay tame, yachol likboa challatan meissa tehora shello hurema challatah, veshettihye zot haissa hattehora kevua lechalla al kol issot sheyyalush min haddemay hattame:

Ad shettissareach. issa zo velo tihye reuya lemaachal adam. shebbaddemay hekellu litrom min hattahor al hattame veshello min hammukkaf, vehekellu nammi litrom min hara al hayyafe. vechallat demay hayenu hallokeach tevua meam haaretz umaachilah laaniyyim velaachsanya, keditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay. vechalla shemmafrishim mimmenna hi challat demay:
Vehikdichato yora. shesserafato yora. shehirticho yoter midday:
Noten lo deme tzamro. vehacha lekka shevacha kelal, shehare nisraf legamre, velekka lememar im hashshevach yater:
Tzevao chaur. kemo kaur. shetztzevao bifsolet shel tzeva. umazzik bechavvana hu, lefichach yado al hattachtona ledivre hakkol:
Im hashshevach. shehishbiach hatztzemer:

Yater al hayetzia. shel tzeva. noten lo latztzabba et hayetzia velo sachar shalem, umekabbel tzamro. udeme tzamro lo amrinan denetiv leh denikne ihu shevacha detzemer, deha betzeva shehitna immo tzava velekka shinnuya denikne:
Litzboa lo adom vechulei. kanye beshinnuy. lerabbi meir lo yahev ella deme tzamro, o ze yitten secharo mishshalem veyikkach hatztzemer:

Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. dekanes leh lehay deshinna lihyot yado al hattachtona velo nithanne mishshevacha, veagra nammi lo nishkol ella yetzia. veim yetzia yetera al hashshevach, yitten lo hashshevach shehishbiach. veim yirtze latet et secharo mishshalem, sheshshevach yoter al hassachar, yitten secharo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Heela vechorot mibbavel velo kibbelu mimmennu. dichtiv (Devarim 14) veachalta lifne Adonai‏ elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha, mimmakom sheatta mevi masar dagan atta mevi bechorot, michutz laaretz shei atta mevi masar dagan en atta mevi bechorot:

Hevi vikkurim yayin veshemen velo kibbelu mimmennu. lefi shello vetzarum mittechilla lechach, deillu vetzarum mittechilla lechach share, dehachi tenan perek batra ditrumot, en meviin bikkurim mashke ella hayyotze min hazzetim vaanavim bilvad:
Pesach katan. pesach sheni. uvanav ketannim hayu, uvefesach rishon bilvad hen chayyavim, shehakkol chayyavim biriyya kedichtiv (Shemot 23) yerae chol zechurecha, aval lo befesach sheni:
Meappamya. garsinan, vehu shem makom besureya:
Kekone befarvare yerushalayim. migreshe yerushalayim uchefarim shessevivoteha. targum migrasheha farvaha:
Eved veishsha shechavlu baacherim peturim. sheen lahem bamme leshallem:

Nitgarsha haishsha venishtachrer haeved. vekanu nechasim. chayyavin leshallem. shehare mittechilla hen chayyavin, ella sheen lahem ma leshallem. shennichse melog shel ishsha meshubadim labbaal leferot velirushsha:
Shennisdeka temea midras. dechevan shennisdeka veenah reuya lelisha, meyachadin otah lishiva:
Temea teme met. dichli tashmish hi:
Habbaa vammidda. shemmachzeket arbaim sea belach shehen korayim beyavesh:
Tehora mikkelum. shemmippene chavdah vegadlah enah mittaltelet melea, vaanan dumeya desak bainan demittaltel male verekan:

Hacherem. leshon metzodim vacharamim (Kohelet 7). reshet asuya michutim niksharim ze vaze uvo nekavim nekavim, ella sheyyesh meat betachtit hareshet shehu arug keveged, vekaruy zuto. vehareshet kullah mekabbelet tuma mippene haarug keveged shebbetachtitah:
Harshatot vehammichmarot. mine metzodot shetztzadin bahen chayyot veofot vedagim:
Maddaf. hatztzayyadin shetztzadin ofot meviin luach shel etz umannichim tachat halluach chittin o fetitim, vehaof ba leechol otam venofel haddaf alav venitpas:
Pelatzur. min metzoda shel etz:
Hassecharin. hassotmim vesochrim et hammayim. leshon vayyissachru mayenot tehom (Bereshit 8):
Temeim. mekabbelim tuma im nagu vemet o sheretz:
Akon. sal shetztzadim bo dagim:
Retov. sal shetztzadim bo ofot:
Keluv. asuy minnetzarim shel arava kelufa o miggemi, veyesh chalal keetzba o fachot ben netzer lenetzer, umannichim sham ofot. vekorim lo belaaz 21. uvammikra, kichluv male of (yirmeya 5):
Mashpelot. kuppot asuyot lehotzi vahem zevalim lassadot:
Shel zevel temea midras. lefi sheruya lishiva:

Vehappuchlatz. asuy keen michbar maase reshet, vehannekavim shello rechavim yoter mimmashpelet shel teven. veenah reuya afillu lekabbel teven, shennekaveha rechavim beyoter, vegam enah reuya lishiva, shechavalim shellah kashim veen reuyin leshev alehen, hilkach tehora mikkelum:
Venishtayyer bo shoresh. mechubbar lakkarka shello neekar:
Kemachat shel mittuach. garsinan, kelomar shiur ovi hashshoresh kemachat shehaorgim motchim bo habbeged achar shearaguhu, lehafeshito uleharchivo:
Shel yadayim temea midras. lefi sheppeamim notnah al hakkeset veyashen aleha:
Veshel tachrich nivle vene levi. shehayu haleviyyim korchim kele hashshir shellahen bemitpachat. vederech shear bene adam laasot lahen tik shel or, veaf hen tehorim:
Umatzu natua. patur. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) ki tavou el haaretz unetatem, perat lenatu ovde chochavim ad shello vau laaretz:
Natu. ben yisrael ben ovde chochavim leachar shebbau laaretz, af al pi shello chavshu yisrael et haaretz, chayyav, dichtiv (sham) kol etz ben netao yisrael ben netao oved kochavim:
Hannotea larabbim. shennata birshuto letzorech rabbim:
Chayyav. dichtiv (sham) yihye lachem arelim, lehavi hannatua larabbim:
Verabbi yehuda poter. savar unetatem nammi mashma larabbim, veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet. verabbanan savre unetatem kol echad leatzmo mashma. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vehannotea birshut harabbim. letzorech atzmo:
Vehaoved kochavim shennata. besade shel yisrael:
Vehaggazlan. sheggazal karka unetaah, venityaashu habbealim mimmenna:
Vehannotea bisfina. af al pi sheenah nekuva, im hi shel cheres, lefi sheen keli cheres omed bifne hashsharashim vehen mefapein derech hacheres veyonkim min hakkarka. aval shel etz bae nekiva:
Vehaole meelav. vedavka bimkom yishshuv, aval bimkom yearim umidbarot lo:
Hatteruma maala et haarla. mitztarefet im hachullin levattel et haarla. vechen haarla mitztarefet im hachullin levattel et hatteruma:
Shennafla lemea. lav davka mea ella pachot mimmea, deillu mea mammash ole velo vae tzeruf, ella hachi kaamar hatteruma shennafla lechullin venaasa hakkol mea:

Veachar kach naflu shelosha kabbin shel arla. setam matnitin kerabbi yehoshua deamar beferek kamma ditrumot ditruma ola bemea veod, hilkach keshennafla sea shel teruma letishim vatesha shel chullin, vechazru venaflu sham shelosha kabbin shel arla umitztarfin im hachullin, shennimtzeu sham tishim vatesha veod shelosha kabbin chullin, hare sea shel teruma betela bemea veod. i nammi matzinan leokmah kerabbi eliezer dehilcheta kevateh deamar teruma ola beechad umea, uchegon shennafla sea shel teruma letoch tishim vetesha sein vachetzi sea shel chullin, ushelosha kabbin hallalu shel arla shehu chatzi sea mitztarfin im hachullin lehashelim leshiur mea shel chullin kede shettaale beechad umea:
Zo hi shehatteruma maala et haarla. sheotah sea shel teruma nitztarfa im hachullin lehashelim matayim chatzae sein, lehaalot shelosha kabbin shel arla beechad umatayim:

Vehaarla et hatteruma. dishlosha kabbin shel arla shehen chatzi sea, nitztarfu im hachullin levattel sea shel teruma beechad umea. dichshennafla sea letoch tishim vetesha vachetzi neesru, ucheshechazar venafal sham shelosha kabbin arla o chilayim, hutteru:
Besureya. aratzot shekkavash david, veenah kedosha kikdushshat eretz yisrael:
Rabbi eliezer mechayyev vechulei. kasavar asu sureya keeretz yisrael leinyan maasrot usheviit:
Verabban gamliel poter. desavar lo asu sureya keeretz yisrael, veeno chayyav bammaasrot besureya ella bizman shehakkarka shel yisrael veen leoved kochavim chelek bo:

Rabban gamliel omer shete challot besureya. kederech shemmafrishim shete challot bechutza laaretz, haachat nisrefet mippene shehi temea betumat eretz haammim, vehashshenit tinnaten lakkohen kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael:
Verabbi eliezer omer challa echat. rabbi eliezer letaameh deamar asu sureya keeretz yisrael veen afarah metamme kaafar eretz haammim, hilkach challa achat vetu lo:
Achazu kullo shel rabban gamliel. defoter sureya mimmaasrot usheviit:

Vekullo shel rabbi eliezer. deomer besureya challa echat. vaanan kayma lan shehaose kekulle demar uchekulle demar rasha, hilkach chazru laasot kerabban gamliel bishte derachim, sheen sureya keeretz yisrael lo leinyan maasrot usheviit kesheyyesh leoved kochavim chelek bakkarka, velo leinyan challa. vechen halacha:
Leanshe mishmar umet. kodem shehevi karban. en yorshe haggazlan yecholim lehotzi miyyad hakkohanim, meachar shezzachu bahen kevar:
Lihoyariv. hi mishmara rishona shel esrim vearba mishmerot kehunna shebbammikdash. veshel yedaya achareha:

Natan. haggazlan et hakkesef lihoyariv bemishmarto, veachar kach natan haasham lidaya bemishmarto, yatza. kedimfaresh veazel, shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi karban ashamo, yatza. veze hammishmar zacha beshello, veze beshello. aval natan asham lihoyariv, shehevi ashamo techilla, veachar kach hevi gezelo venatan lammishmar shelleacharav, im haasham kayyam, shello hikrivuhu bene yehoyariv, yakrivuhu bene yedaya vihe gezelo vaashamo lidaya. veim en ashamo kayyam, lo yatza baasham shennatan lihoyariv, kevan shello natan gezelo. veyachzor veyavi asham acher:
Natan hakkeren. lakkohanim:
En hachomesh meakkev. millehakriv et haasham, im lo natan adayin ulevassof natan:

Hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh levanav o leechav. im en lo banim. veaf al gav denafla yerushsha kammeh dehaich, bae lemeevad hashava veen meakkev etzlo afillu keneged chelko. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) veheshiv et haggezela, en lo takkana ad sheyyotzi gezelo mittachat yado. uvilvad shettehe haggezela been, delo kanye beshinnuy:
En lo. nechasim kol kach sheyyachol levatter al chelko:
O sheeno rotze. lehafesid chelko:
Love. meacherim, umachzir et haggazel leechav lekayyem mitzvat hashava:
Uvaale hachov. shellava ze haggazlan mehem:

Baim venifraim. min haggezela hazzot hachelek sheyyesh laggazlan bah. veim en yoresh leaviv ella hu, noten hu atzmo haggezela levaal chovo befiron hachov, vetzarich lehodio velomar lo ze gazal abba. o noten al derech ze lichtubbat ishto o lekuppat hatztzedaka. uvechullan tzarich sheyyodia shezze gezel aviv:
Mappatzim. kemin machtzelaot asuyot mechilaf umissiv vekane vegome vegemi vechayyotze vahen:
Veshel tzabbaim. shehatztzabbaim notnim alehem habbegadim:
Tame teme met. sheenam meyuchadim lishiva, aval torat kelim yesh lahen:
Veshel gittot. haasuyot lechassot bahen anavim vezetim:

Vehaarla et haarla. tzarich lomar deechad mehem neta revai, shehem shene shemot, dei efshar leissur shel shem echad sheyyihye mevattel ketzato liktzato. vekare tana leneta revai arla, shemmin haarla hu va. ulehachi katane haarla et haarla velo katane hakkilayim et hakkilayim, sheen bakkilayim shene shemot kemo sheyyesh baarla:

Shennafla lematayim. lav lematayim davka deillu matayim mammash lo vae tzeruf. ucheshennafla sea arla letoch mea tishim vatesha shel hetter neesru, ucheshechazar venafal sham sea vaod shel kilayim mitztarfim im hammea tishim vatesha levattel haarla. vechen haarla mitztarefet im hammea tishim vatesha levattel sea veod shel kile hakkerem. vehayenu kerabbi yehoshua deit leh dearla betela bematayim veod, kemo teruma bemea veod, hilkach sea shel kilayim betela bemea tishim vatesha umashshehu, vehaod batel bisa chaser mashshehu. vechen nammi im nafal sham sea veod shel neta revai, mitztarfin im hammea tishim vatesha levattel et hassea shel arla shennafla, veasra hakkol, vechen sea shel arla mitztarefet im hammea tishim vatesha shel hetter levattel sea veod shel neta revai shennaflu baacharona:
Ilan shenneekar. sheakarto haruach o shetafo nahar veholicho lemakom acher:
